Mishneh Torah, Repentance 10:
Al yomar adam hareni ose mitzvot hattora veosek bechachmatah kede sheakabbel kol habberachot hakketuvot bah o kede sheezke lechayye haolam habba, veefrosh min haaverot shehizhira tora mehen kede sheennatzel min hakkelalot hakketuvot battora o kede shello ekkaret mechayye haolam habba. en rauy laavod et Adonai al hadderech hazze, shehaoved al derech ze hu oved miyyira veenah maalat hanneviim velo maalat hachachamim. veen ovdim Adonai al derech ze ella amme haaretz vehannashim vehakketannim shemmechannechin otan laavod miyyira ad shettirbe datan veyaavdu meahava:
Haoved meahava osek battora uvammitzvot veholech bintivot hachachma lo mippene davar baolam velo mippene yirat haraa velo kede lirash hattova ella ose haemet mippene shehu emet vesof hattova lavo biglalah. umaala zo hi maala gedola meod veen kol chacham zoche lah. vehi maalat avraham avinu shekkerao hakkadosh baruch hu ohavo lefi shello avad ella meahava. vehi hammaala shetztzivvanu bah hakkadosh baruch hu al yede moshe shenneemar <small>(Devarim 6 5)</small> "veahavta et Adonai elohecha". uvizman sheyyeehov adam et Adonai ahava haruya miyyad yaase kol hammitzvot meahava:
Vechetzad hi haahava haruya. hu sheyyohav et Adonai ahava gedola yetera azza meod ad shettehe nafsho keshura beahavat Adonai venimtza shoge bah tamid keillu chole choli haahava sheen dato penuya meahavat otah ishsha vehu shoge bah tamid ben beshivto ben bekumo ben beshaa shehu ochel veshote. yeter mizze tihye ahavat Adonai belev ohavav shogim bah tamid kemo shetztzivvanu bechol levavcha uvechol nafshecha. vehu sheshshelomo amar derech mashal <small>(Shir HaShirim 2 5)</small> "ki cholat ahava ani". vechol shir hashshirim mashal hu leinyan ze:
Amru chachamim harishonim shemma tomar hareni lamed tora bishvil sheehye ashir bishvil sheekra rabbi bishvil sheakabbel sachar baolam habba. talmud lomar <small>(Devarim 11 13)</small> "leahava et Adonai". kol ma sheattem osim lo taasu ella meahava. veod amru chachamim bemitzvotav chafetz meod velo bischar mitzvotav. vechen hayu gedole hachachamim metzavvim linvone talmidehem umaskilehem beyichud al tihyu kaavadim hameshammeshim et harav vechulei ella mippene shehu harav rauy leshammesho kelomar ivdu meahava:
Kol haosek battora kede lekabbel sachar o kede shello taggia alav puranut hare ze osek shello lishmah. vechol haosek bah lo leyira velo lekabbel sachar ella mippene ahavat adon kol haaretz shetztzivva bah hare ze osek bah lishmah. veamru chachamim leolam yaasok adam battora vaafillu shello lishmah shemmittoch shello lishmah ba lishmah. lefichach keshemmelammedin et hakketannim veet hannashim uchelal amme haaretz en melammedin otan ella laavod miyyira uchede lekabbel sachar, ad shettirbe datan veyitchakkemu chachma yetera megallim lahem raz ze meat meat umargilin otan leinyan ze benachat ad sheyyassiguhu veyeduhu veyaavduhu meahava:
Davar yadua uvarur sheen ahavat hakkadosh baruch hu niksheret belibbo shel adam ad sheyyishge bah tamid karauy veyaazov kol ma shebbaolam chutz mimmenna. kemo shetztzivva veamar bechol levavcha uvechol nafshecha. eno ohev hakkadosh baruch hu ella bedaat sheyyedaehu. veal pi haddea tihye haahava im meat meat veim harebe harebe. lefichach tzarich haadam leyached atzmo lehavin ulehaskil bechachmot utevunot hammodiim lo et kono kefi koach sheyyesh baadam lehavin ulehassig kemo shebbearnu behilchot yesode hattora:
Mishneh Torah, Rest on a Holiday 1:
Sheshet yamim haellu sheasaran hakkatuv baasiyyat melacha shehen rishon ushevii shel pesach verishon ushemini shel chag hassukkot uveyom chag hashshavuot uveechad lachodesh hashshevii hen hannikrain yamim tovim. ushevitat kullan shava shehen asurin bechol melechet avoda chutz mimmelacha shehi letzorech achila shenneemar <small>(Shemot 12 16)</small> "ach asher yeachel lechol nefesh" vegomer: 
Kol hashshovet mimmelechet avoda beechad mehen hare kiyyem mitzvat ase shehare neemar bahen <small>(Vayikra 23 24)</small> <small>(Vayikra 23 39)</small> "shabbaton" kelomar shevot. vechol haose beechad mehen melacha sheenah letzorech achila kegon shebbana o haras o arag vechayyotze baellu hare bittel mitzvat ase veavar al lo taase. shenneemar kol melechet avoda lo taasu. <small>(Shemot 12 16)</small> "kol melacha lo yease vahem". veim asa beedim vehateraa loke min hattora: 
Haose avot melachot harebe beyom tov behateraa achat kegon shezzara uvana vesatar vearag behateraa achat eno loke ella achat. chilluk melachot leshabbat veen chilluk melachot leyom tov: 
Kol melacha shechayyavin aleha beshabbat im asa otah beyom tov shello letzorech achila loke chutz min hahotzaa mershut lirshut vehahavara shemmittoch shehuttera hotzaa beyom tov letzorech achila huttera shello letzorech achila. lefichach muttar beyom tov lehotzi katan o sefer tora o mafteach vechayyotze beellu mershut lirshut. vechen muttar lehaveir af al pi sheeno letzorech achila. ushear melachot kol sheyyesh bo tzorech achila muttar kegon shechita vaafiyya velisha vechayyotze bahen. vechol sheen bahen tzorech achila asur kegon ketiva vaariga uvinyan vechayyotze bahen: 
Kol melacha sheefshar leheasot meerev yom tov velo yihye bah hefsed velo chesron im naaset mibbaerev asru chachamim laasot otah beyom tov af al pi shehi letzorech achila. velamma asru davar ze gezera shemma yaniach adam melachot sheefshar laasotan meerev yom tov leyom tov venimtza yom tov kullo holech baasiyyat otan melachot veyimmana missimchat yom tov velo yihye lo penay leechol: 
Umizze hattaam atzmo lo asru hahotzaa beyom tov veaf al pi shekkol hahotzaa hi melacha sheefshar laasotah meerev yom tov velamma lo asaruha kede leharebot besimchat yom tov veyolich veyavi kol ma sheyyirtze veyashlim chafatzav velo yihye kemi sheyyadav asurot. aval shear melachot sheefshar laasotan meerev yom tov hoil veyesh bahen esek en osin otan beyom tov: 
Ketzad. en kotzrin velo dashin velo zorin velo borrin velo tochanin et hachittim velo merakkedin beyom tov shekkol ellu vechayyotze bahem efshar laasotan meerev yom tov veen bechach hefsed velo chesron: 
Aval lashin veofin veshochatin umevashshelin beyom tov. sheim asa ellu mibbaerev yesh bechach hefsed o chesron taam. sheen lechem cham o tavshil shebbishshel hayyom kelechem shenneefa meemesh uchetavshil shenitbashshel meemesh. velo basar shennishchat hayyom kevasar shennishchat meemesh. vechen kol kayyotze beellu. vechen machshire ochel nefesh sheyyesh bahen chesron im naasu mibbaerev osin otan beyom tov. kegon shechikat tavlin vechayyotze bahen: 
En ofin umevashshelin beyom tov ma sheyyeachel bechol. velo huttera melacha shehi letzorech achila ella kede lehanot bah beyom tov. asa kede leechol beyom tov vehotir muttar leechol hammotar bechol: 
Memallea ishsha kedera basar af al pi sheenah tzericha ella lachaticha achat. memalle nachtom chavit shel mayim af al pi sheeno tzarich ella lekiton echad. umemallea ishsha tannur pat af al pi sheenah tzericha ella lechikkar echad. shebbizman shehappat merubba battannur hi neefet yafe. umoleach adam kamma chatichot basar bevat achat af al pi sheeno tzarich ella lachaticha achat. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Hamevashshel o haofe beyom tov kede leechol bo bayyom o shezzimmen orchim velo bau venishar hattavshil vehappat hare ze muttar leechol lemachar ben bechol ben beshabbat. uvilvad shello yaarim. veim heerim asur vaafillu beshabbat sheachar yom tov mippene shehechmiru bemaarim yoter min hammezid: 
Mi shehayta lo behema mesukkenet lo yishchot otah beyom tov ella im ken yodea sheyyachol leechol mimmenna kezayit tzali mibbeod yom. kede shello yishchot beyom tov ma sheyyochal bechol. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
En ofin umevashshelin beyom tov kede lehaachil kutim o kelavim shenneemar <small>(Shemot 12 16)</small> "hu levaddo yease lachem" lachem velo lechutim lachem velo lichlavim. lefichach mezammenin et hakkuti beshabbat veen mezammenin oto beyom tov gezera shemma yarbe bishvilo. aval im ba hakkuti meelav ochel immahen ma shehen ochlin shekkevar hechinuha: 
Behema shechetzyah shel kuti vechetzyah shel yisrael muttar leshochotah beyom tov shei efshar leechol mimmenna kezayit basar belo shechita. aval issa shechetzyah lechutim vechetzyah leyisrael asur leefot otah mippene sheyyachol lechallek habbatzek. bene hachayil shennatnu kemach leyisrael laasot lahem pat beyom tov. im keshennotnin pat mimmenna letinok en makpidin muttar leefoto lahen beyom tov shekkol pat ufat rauy lattinok. issat hakkelavim bizman sheharoim ochlin mimmenna neefet beyom tov: 
Hamevashshel beyom tov lechutim o livhema o lehanniach lechol eno loke sheillu bau lo orchim haya oto tavshil rauy lahen. asa lenafsho vehotir muttar lehaachil mimmennu lechutim velivhema: 
Rechitza vesicha hare hen bichlal achila ushetiyya veosin otan beyom tov shenneemar <small>(Shemot 12 16)</small> "ach asher yeachel lechol nefesh" lechol shetztzarich hagguf. lefichach mechimmin chammin beyom tov verochetz bahen panav yadav veraglav. aval kol gufo asur mishshum gezerat merchatz. vechammin shehuchammu meerev yom tov rochetz bahen kol gufo beyom tov shello gazru al davar ze ella beshabbat bilvad: 
Kol sheasur beshabbat ben mishshum shehu dome limlacha o mevi lide melacha ben shehu mishshum shevut hare hu asur beyom tov ella im ken haya bo tzorech achila vechayyotze bah. o devarim shehem muttarim beyom tov kemo sheyyitbaer bahalachot ellu. vechol sheasur letaltelo beshabbat asur letaltelo beyom tov ella letzorech achila vechayyotze bah. vechol shemmuttar beshabbat muttar beyom tov. veyesh beyom tov ma sheen beshabbat issur muktze shehammuktze asur beyom tov umuttar beshabbat mippene sheyyom tov kal mishshabbat asru bo hammuktze shemma yavo lezalzel bo: 
Ketzad. tarnegolet haomedet legaddel betzim veshor haomed lacharisha veyone shovach uferot haomdin lischora kol ellu vechayyotze bahen muktze hen veasur leechol mehen beyom tov ad sheyyachin otam mibbaerev veyachashov alehem laachila. aval beshabbat hakkol muchan etzel shabbat veeno tzarich hachana. ucheshem shehammuktze asur beyom tov kach hannolad asur: 
Chol mechin leshabbat vechol mechin leyom tov aval en yom tov mechin leshabbat velo shabbat mechina leyom tov. lefichach betza shennolda beyom tov achar hashshabbat asura. veaf al pi shehattarnegolet omedet laachila. hoil umeemesh nigmera habbetza nimtza shabbat mechin otah leyom tov. vaasaruha bechol yom tov gezera mishshum yom tov sheachar shabbat. vechen betza shennolda bechol shabbat asura gezera mishshum shabbat sheachar yom tov: 
Ucheshem sheasur leachlah kach asur letaltelah vaafillu nitarva beelef kullan asurot shehare lemachar yutteru hakkol vechol davar sheyyesh lo mattirin afillu beelef alafim eno batel. hashshochet tarnegolet beyom tov umatza bah betzim gemurot hare ellu muttarot. sheen ze davar matzuy tamid vedavar sheeno matzuy ella akray bealma lo gazru bo: 
Ze sheanu osin bechutza laaretz kol yom tov meellu shene yamim minhag hu. veyom tov sheni middivre sofrim hu umiddevarim shennitchaddeshu baggalut. veen osin bene eretz yisrael shene yamim tovim ella berosh hashshana bilvad. uvehilchot kiddush hachodesh missefer ze nevaer ikkar minhag ze umee ze taam osin rosh hashshana shene yamim bechol makom: 
Yom tov sheni af al pi shehu middivre sofrim kol davar sheasur barishon asur bashsheni. vechol hamechallel yom tov sheni vaafillu shel rosh hashshana ben bedavar shehu mishshum shevut ben bimlacha ben sheyyatza chutz lattechum makkin oto makkat mardut o menaddin oto im lo yihye min hattalmidim. ucheshem sheharishon asur bahesped vetaanit vechayyav besimcha kach hashsheni veen benehen hefresh ella leinyan met bilvad: 
Ketzad. hammet beyom tov rishon yitasseku bikvurato hakkutim uveyom tov sheni yitasseku bo yisrael. veosin lo kol tzerachav kegon asiyyat hammitta utefirat hattachrichin uketzitzat habbesamim vechol kayyotze baze. sheyyom tov sheni legabbe hammet kechol hu chashuv vaafillu bishne yamim tovim shel rosh hashshana: 
Shene yamim tovim ellu shel galuyyot shete kedushshot hen veenan keyom echad lefichach davar shehaya muktze beyom tov rishon o shennolad barishon im hechin oto lashsheni hare ze muttar. ketzad. betza shennolda barishon teachel bashsheni. chayya veof shennitztzodu barishon yeachlu bashsheni. davar hamechubbar lakkarka shenneekar barishon yeachel bashsheni. vechen muttar lichchol et haayin beyom tov sheni veaf al pi sheen sham choli. bamme devarim amurim bishne yamim tovim shel galuyyot aval shene yamim shel rosh hashshana kedushsha achat hen ucheyom echad hen chashuvim lechol ellu haddevarim ella leinyan hammet bilvad. aval betza shennolda barishon shel rosh hashshana asura bashsheni. vechen kol kayyotze baze. shabbat hassemucha leyom tov venolda betza beechad mehen asura bashsheni. vechen kol kayyotze baze vaafillu nolda beyom sheni lo teachel beshabbat hassemucha lo:
Mishneh Torah, Rest on a Holiday 2:
Efroach shennolad beyom tov asur mippene shehu muktze. veegel shennolad beyom tov im hayta immo omedet laachila muttar mippene shehu muchan al gabbe immo veillu shachat immo haya ze shebbemeeha muttar beyom tov af al pi shello nolad: 
Behemot sheyyotzot veroot chutz lattechum uvaot velanot betoch hattechum hare ellu muchanin velokchin mehen veshochatin otan beyom tov. aval haroot velanot chutz lattechum im bau beyom tov en shochatin otan beyom tov mippene shehen muktzin veen daat anshe hair alehem: 
Vechen behemat kadashim shennolad bah mum beyom tov hoil velo hayta dato aleha meerev yom tov asur leshochotah beyom tov. lefichach asur lirot mume kadashim beyom tov gezera shemma yattirem hechacham bemuman veyavo ze lishchot bo bayyom. aval roe hu hammum meerev yom tov ulemachar mattir o oser: 
Bechor shennolad umumo immo hare ze muchan veen mevakkerim oto beyom tov. veim avar veraa mumo uvikkero vehittiro hare ze shochet veochel. bechor shennafal labbor ose lo parnasa bimkomo shehare eno yachol lehaaloto mippene sheeno rauy lishchita beyom tov. <small>(Vayikra 22 28)</small> "oto veet beno" shennaflu labbor maale et harishon al menat leshochoto veeno shochato. umaarim umaale et hashsheni al menat leshochoto veshochet et e ze mehen sheyyirtze. mishshum tzaar baale chayyim hittiru lehaarim. behemat chullin shennafla min haggag veamda meet leet vahare hi tzericha bedika shochatin otah beyom tov vetibbadek efshar shettimmatze keshera veteachel: 
Avazin vetarnegolin veyonim shebbabbayit hare ellu muchanin veen tzerichin zimmun. aval yone shovach veyone aliyya vetzipporim shekkinnenu bitfichin o bechira uvappardes hare ellu muktze. vetzarich lezammen mibbaerev velomar ellu veellu ani notel veeno tzarich lenaanea: 
Zimmen shechorim ulevanim umatza shechorim bimkom levanim ulevanim bimkom shechorim asurim sheani omer shemma otan shezzimmen parchu lahen veellu acherim hen vechol safek muchan asur. zimmen shenayim umatza shelosha hakkol asur. shelosha umatza shenayim muttarin. zimmen betoch hakken umatza lifne hakken im en sham bakken ella hen veenan yecholin lifroach af al pi sheyyesh sham ken acher bekeren zavit betoch chamishshim amma hare ellu muttarin sheen hamedadde medadde ella keneged kinno beshave: 
Dagim shebbevevarin gedolim vechen chayya vaof shebbevevarin gedolim kol shehu mechussar tzida ad sheomrim have metzuda unetzudennu hare ze muktze veen tzadin otan beyom tov veim tzad lo yochlo. vechol sheeno tzarich metzuda hare ze muchan vetzadin oto beyom tov veochlin oto. vechen chayya shekkinnena befardes hassamuch lair yeladeha keshehen ketannim sheenan tzerichin tzida enam tzerichim zimmun mippene sheddato alehen: 
Metzudot chayya veofot vedagim shepperasan meerev yom tov lo yittol mehen beyom tov ella im ken yodea shennitztzodu meerev yom tov. hassocher ammat hammayim meerev yom tov ulemachar hishkim umatza bah dagim hare ellu muttarin shekkevar nitztzodu meerev yom tov vahare hen muchanin: 
Bayit shehi male perot muchanin venifchat notel mimmekom happechat. haomed al hammuktze meerev yom tov bashshana hashsheviit shekkol happerot hefker tzarich sheyyirshom veyomar mikkan vead kan ani notel veim lo rasham lo yittol: 
Kuti shehevi teshura leyisrael beyom tov im yesh meoto hammin bimchubbar lakkarka o shehevi chayya o ofot o dagim sheefshar letzudan bo bayyom hare ellu asurin ad laerev veyamtin bichde sheyyeasu. vaafillu hadas vechayyotze bo eno meriach bo laerev ad sheyyamtin bichde sheyyeasu. veim en meoto hammin bimchubbar lakkarka o shehayta tzurato muchachat alav shemmeetmol neekar o nitztzod im hevio mittoch hattechum muttar veim hevio michutz lattechum hare ze asur. vehabba bishvil yisrael ze michutz lattechum muttar leyisrael acher: 
Etzim shennashru min haddekel beyom tov asur lehassikan mippene shehen nolad. veim nashru letoch hattannur marbe alehen etzim muchanin umassikan. aremat hatteven veotzar shel etzim en matchilin bahen beyom tov ella im ken hechin mibbaerev mippene shehen muktze. veim haya hatteven meorav bekotzim shehare eno rauy ella leesh hare ze muchan: 
En mevakkein etzim missavavr shel korot mippene shehen muktze. velo min hakkora shennishbera beyom tov mippene shehi nolad. vechen kelim shennishberu beyom tov en massikin bahen mippene shehen nolad. aval massikin bechelim shelemim o bechelim shennishberu meerev yom tov shehare huchenu limlacha acheret mibbaerev. kayyotze bo egozim ushekedim sheachalan meerev yom tov massikin biklippehen beyom tov. veim achalan beyom tov en massikin biklippehen. veyesh nuschaot sheyyesh bahen sheim achalan mibbaerev en massikin biklippehen shehare huktzu veim achalan beyom tov massikin mippene shehen muchanin al gav haochel: 
Kotz ratov hare hu muktze mippene sheeno rauy lehassaka. lefichach asur lo laasoto kemo shippud litzlot bo basar. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Notlin etzim hassemuchim ledafne hassukka umassikin bahen. aval en meviim min hassade afillu hayu mechunnasin sham mibbaerev. aval megabbev hu bassade millefanav umadlik sham. umeviin min hamechunnasin shebbirshut hayyachid vaafillu hayta mukkefet shello leshem dira uvilvad sheyyihye lah potachat vetihye betoch techum shabbat. veim chaser echad mikkol ellu hare hen muktze: 
Ale kanim vaale gefanim af al pi shehen mechunnasin bekarpaf kevan sheharuach mefazzeret otan hare hen kimfuzzarin vaasurin. veim hinniach alehen keli kaved meerev yom tov hare ellu muchanin: 
Behema shemmeta beyom tov im hayta mesukkenet meerev yom tov hare ze mechattechah lakkelavim. veim lav hoil velo hayta dato aleha hare ze muktze velo yazzizennah mimmekomah. behemat kadashim shemmeta uteruma shennitmet lo yazzizennah mimmekomah: 
Dagim veofot vechayya shehen muktze en mashkin otan beyom tov veen notnin lifnehem mezonot shemma yavo likkach mehen. vechol sheasur leachlo o lehishtammesh bo beyom tov mippene shehu muktze asur letaltelo: 
Hammachnis afar meerev yom tov im yiched lo bachatzero keren zavit hare ze muchan umuttar letaltelo velaasot bo kol tzerachav. vechen efer shehussak meerev yom tov muchan. veshehussak beyom tov kol zeman shehu cham kede litzlot bo betza muttar letaltelo sheadayin esh hu. veim lav asur letaltelo mippene shehu nolad. mi shehaya lo deker nautz meerev yom tov venitteko beyom tov veheela afar im haya oto afar tichoach hare ze mechasse bo umetaltelo. aval im heela gush afar hare ze lo yichtosh oto beyom tov:
Mishneh Torah, Rest on a Holiday 3:
Mi shehaya lo afar muchan o efer muchan shemmuttar letaltelo hare ze shochet chayya vaof umechasse damam. veim en lo afar muchan o efer harauy letaltelo hare ze lo yishchot veim avar veshachat lo yechasse damam ad laerev. vechen beriyya shehu safek im chayya hi im behema en shochatin otah beyom tov veim shachat lo yechasse damah ad laerev. afillu haya lo afar muchan o efer. shemma yomar haroe chayya vaddait hi ulefichach kissa damo beyom tov veyavo haroe lehattir chelbo: 
Vechen hashshochet chayya vaof meerev yom tov lo yechasse damam beyom tov. shachat behema chayya vaof beyom tov venitarev damam lo yechasse oto ad laerev. veim haya lo afar muchan o efer veyachol lechassot hakkol bidkira achat hare ze yechassehu: 
Hashshochet behema beyom tov muttar lo litlosh tzemer limkom hassakkin beyado. uvilvad shello yezizennu mimmekomo ella yishshaer sham mesubbach kishar tzemer hatztzavvar. aval beof lo yimrot mippene shehu darko venimtza tolesh beyom tov: 
Hammafshit or behema beyom tov lo yimlachennu shezze ibbud hu venimtza ose melacha shello letzorech achila. aval notno lifne bet hadderisa kede sheyyidresu alav velo yippased. velo hittiru davar ze ella mippene simchat yom tov kede shello yimmana millishchot. umuttar limloach basar letzali al gabbe haor. umaarimim bedavar ze. ketzad. moleach meat basar mikkan umeat mikkan ad sheyyimlach haor kullo: 
Bamme devarim amurim bemoleach letzali sheeno tzarich melach harebe aval likdera asur limloach al haor. vechen en molchin et hachalavim veen mehappechin bahen veen shotchin otan baruach al gabbe yetedot mippene sheenan reuyin laachila: 
Hammafshit et habbehema lo yargil beyom tov. ketzad hu hammargil. ze hammotzi kol basar meregel achat kede sheyyotzi kol haor shalem velo yikkara. mippene shettoreach behefshet ze torach gadol veen bo tzorech lammoed. vechen asur laasot bet yad babbasar vehu sheyyaase besakkin shello yaase kederech shehu ose bechol. umuttar laasot siman babbasar: 
Molgin et harosh veet haraglayim umehavhavin otan baur. aval en toflin otan besid uvecharsit velo baadama veen gozzin otan bemisparayim. vechen en gozzin et hayyarak betisporet shello aval metakkenin et haochel sheyyesh bo kotzim kegon kundas veakkeviyyot betisporet: 
Muttar lalush issa gedola beyom tov. vehallash issa meerev yom tov eno mafrish mimmenna challa beyom tov. veim lashah beyom tov mafrish mimmenna challa venotnah lakkohen. veim hayta issa temea o shennitmet hachalla lo yevashshel et hachalla sheen mevashshelin beyom tov ella leechol vezo lisrefa omedet. vechen en sorfin otah beyom tov sheen sorfin kadashim shennitmeu beyom tov. shesserefat kadashim shennitmeu mitzvat ase shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 7 19)</small> "baesh yissaref" vaasiyyat melacha sheenah letzorech achila vechayyotze bahen ase velo taase veen ase doche et lo taase vaase: 
Ketzad yaase bah. yenichennah ad haerev veyisrof otah. haya yom tov shel pesach sheim yenichennah tachamitz lo yafrish et hachalla batzek ella yofe et kol haissa hattemea veachar kach yafrish hachalla lechem: 
En ofin befureni chadasha gezera shemma tippachet vetafsid hallechem veyimmana missimchat yom tov. en gorfin tannur vechirayim aval mechabbeshin et haefer shebbahen. veim i efshar leefot bo o litzlot ella im ken garaf muttar. vesotmin pi hattannur betit verefesh shebbisvivot hannahar vehu sherikkecho meemesh aval legabbel tit beyom tov asur. umuttar legabbel et haefer listom bo pi hattannur: 
Tannur vechirayim chadashim en sachin otan beshemen beyom tov. veen tashin otan bematlit. veen mefigin otan betzonen kede lechasman veim bishvil leefot bahen muttar. en melabbenin et haavanim litzlot o leefot alehen mippene shemmechasseman. umassikin veofin befureni umechimmin chammin beantichi: 
En osin gevina beyom tov sheim gibben meerev yom tov en baze chesron taam aval dachin et hattavlin kedarkan sheim yaduch otan mibbaerev yafug taaman. aval melach eno niddoch beyom tov ella im ken hitta hammachtesh o sheyyaduch bikara vechayyotze bah kede sheyyeshanne. sheim shachak hammelach meerev yom tov lo yafug taamo. veen shochakin et happilpelin barechayim shellahen ella dach otan bimducha kechol hattavlin: 
En kotshin et harifot bemachteshet gedola. aval kotshin bemachteshet ketanna shezze hu hashshinnuy shellah. uveeretz yisrael afillu biktanna asur shehattevua shellahen tova hi veim kotshin otam meerev yom tov en bechach hefsed: 
Hakkemach af al pi sherikkedo meerev yom tov vehesir mimmennu hassubbin en merakkedin oto paam sheniyya beyom tov ella im ken nafal betocho tzeror o kesam vechayyotze bahem. veim shinna muttar. ketzad. kegon sheyyerakked meachore hannafa o sherikked al gabbe hashshulchan vechayyotze beshinnuy ze: 
Mollin melilot umefarchin kitnit beyom tov umenappeach al yad al yad bechol kocho veochel vaafillu bekanon o betamchuy aval lo benafa velo bichvara. vechen habborer kitniyyot beyom tov borer kedarko becheko uvetamchuy aval lo benafa velo betavla velo bichvara: 
Bamme devarim amurim keshehaochel merubbe al happesolet aval im hayta happesolet merubba al haochel borer et haochel umeniach et happesolet. veim haya torach bivrerat happesolet min haochel yeter mittorach bivrerat haochel min happesolet af al pi shehaochel merubbe borer et haochel umeniach et happesolet: 
En mesannenin et hachardal bemisnenet shellah mippene shennire kevorer. aval notnin betza bemisnenet shel chardal vehu mistannen meelav. veim hayta hammeshammeret teluya muttar litten lah yayin beyom tov. aval lo yitle battechilla shello yaase kederech shehu ose bechol. umaarim vetole et hammeshammeret litlot bah rimmonim vetole bah rimmonim veachar kach noten letochah shemarim:
Mishneh Torah, Rest on a Holiday 4:
En motziin et haesh lo min haetzim velo min haavanim velo min hammattachot. kegon shechochchin otan zo bazo o makkin zo bazo ad shettetze haesh. vechen hanneft hachad beyoter shehu bemayim shemmenidin otam ad sheyyiddalek. o keli zach kashe o zechuchit melea mayim shemmannichin otah keneged en hashshemesh ad sheyyachazor naghah lappishtan vechayyotze bo veyidlak. kol ze vechayyotze bo asur beyom tov. shello huttar beyom tov ella lehaveir meesh metzuya. aval lehametzi esh asur shehare efshar lehametzi otah mibbaerev: 
Af al pi shehuttera haveara beyom tov shello letzorech asur lechabbot et haesh afillu huvara letzorech achila. shehakkibbuy melacha sheen bo tzorech achila kelal. ucheshem sheen mechabbim et haesh kach en mechabbim et hanner veim kibba loke kemi shearag o bana: 
En mesallekin et pi hanner lemala kede shettichbe. veen mesirin et hashshemen mimmennu veeno chotech et rosh happetila bichli. aval nofetz et roshah beyado. agudda shel etzim shehudleka bimdura kol etz shello achaza bo haesh muttar leshamto veeno dome lemesir shemen min hanner: 
En mechabbin et haddeleka kede lehatztzil mamon beyom tov kederech sheen mechabbin beshabbat ella menichah veyotze. veen mechabbin et hanner mippene tashmish hammitta ella kofe alav keli o ose mechitztza beno leven hanner o motzio levet acher. veim eno yachol laasot achat mikkol ellu hare ze asur lechabbot veasur leshammesh ad shettichbe meeleha: 
Muttar letaltel et hanner vehu dolek veen gozrin shemma yichbe. veasur lehaniach et hanner al gabbe dekel vechayyotze bo beyom tov shemma yavo lehishtammesh bimchubbar beyom tov: 
En meashshenin biktoret beyom tov mippene shehu mechabbe. vaafillu lehariach bah. veen tzarich lomar legammer et habbayit veet hakkelim shehu asur. umuttar leashshen tachat happerot kede sheyyuchsheru laachila kemo shemmuttar litzlot basar al haesh. umemattekin et hachardal begachelet shel mattechet aval lo begachelet shel etz mippene shehu mechabbe. veen mechabbin et haesh kede shello titashshen hakkedera o habbayit: 
En nofchin bemappuach beyom tov kede shello yaase kederech shehaummanin osin. aval nofchin bishfoferet. en osin pechamin veen godlin et happetila velo mehavehavin otah velo chotchin otah lishnayim bichli. aval memaachah bayyad veshore otah beshemen umanniach otah ben shete nerot umadlik baemtza venimtzet happetila nechleket befi shete nerot: 
En shovrin et hacheres veen chotchin et hanneyar litzlot alehem. veen potzin et hakkane laasoto kemo shippud litzlot bo maliach. shippud shennirtzaf af al pi shehu yachol lefashto beyado en metakkenin oto. shene kelim shehen mechubbarin bitchillat asiyyatan kegon shete nerot o shene kosot en pochatin otan lishnayim mippene shehu kimtakken keli: 
En mashchizin et hassakkin bemashchezet shellah aval mechaddedah al gabbe haetz o al gabbe cheres o even veen morim davar ze larabbim kede shello yavou lechaddedah bemashchezet. bamme devarim amurim besheyyechola lachtoch bedochak o shennifgema. aval im enah yechola lachtoch kelal en mashchizin otah afillu al haetz shemma yavo lehashechizah bemashchezet. vmippene ze asru lehareot sakkin lechacham beyom tov shemma tihye peguma veyomar lo asur lishchot bah mishshum pegimatah veyelech vichaddedennah bemashchezet. vechacham sheraa hassakkin leatzmo hare ze mashilah leam haaretz: 
En mevakkein etzim beyom tov lo bekordom velo bemaggal velo bimgera ella bekofitz uvatztzad hachad shello. aval lo batztzad harachav mippene shehi kekordom. velamma asru bekordom vechayyotze bo shello yaase kederech shehu ose bechol shehare efshar haya lo levakkea meerev yom tov. velamma lo neesar habbikkua kelal mippene sheefshar sheyyifga beetz ave velo yuchal lehaveiro veyimmana millevashshel. lefichach hittiru levakkea beshinnuy. vechol haddevarim haddomin laze mizze hattaam hittiru bahen ma shehittiru veasru ma sheasru: 
Lo tikkanes ishsha ben haetzim littol mehen ud litzlot bo. veen somchin et hakkedera velo et haddelet bivkaat shel kora. shello hittiru letaltel etzim beyom tov ella lehassaka bilvad: 
Mesallekin terise chanuyyot umachzirin otan beyom tov kede sheyyotzi tavlin shehu tzarich lahen min hachanut velo yimmana missimchat yom tov. bamme devarim amurim besheyyesh lahen tzir beemtza aval yesh lahen tzir min hatztzad asur gezera shemma yitka. vesheen lahen tzir kol ikkar afillu babbayit muttar lehachazir: 
Kelim shehen mefutztzalin kegon menora shel chulyot vechisse veshulchan shehen chatichot chatichot maamidin otan beyom tov vehu shello yitka. lefi sheen binyan bechelim. avanim shel bet hakkisse muttar letzaddedan beyom tov. binyan aray hu umishshum kevodo lo gazru: 
Haose medura beyom tov keshehu orech et haetzim eno manniach ze al ze ad sheyyasdir hammaaracha mippene shennire kevone. veaf al pi shehu binyan aray asur. ella o shofech haetzim beirbuv o orech beshinnuy. ketzad. manniach etz lemala umanniach acher tachtav veacher tachtav ad shehu maggia laaretz: 
Vechen hakkedera ochez otah umachnis haavanim tachteha. aval lo yannichennah al gabbe haavanim. vechen hammitta ochez hakkerashim lemala umachnis haraglayim tachtehen. afillu betzim lo yaamid otan beshura al gabbe shura ad sheyyaamdu kemo migdal ella yeshanne veyatchil millemala lematta. vechen kol kayyotze baze tzarich shinnuy: 
Mesirin zevuvin hannitlim babbehema af al pi shehen osin chabbura. veen meyalledin et habbehema beyom tov aval mesaadin. ketzad. ochez bavvalad shello yippol laaretz venofeach lo bechatmo venoten dad letoch piv. hayta behema tehora verichaka et havvalad muttar lezallef mishshilyatah alav velitten bul melach berachmah kede shetterachem alav. aval hattemea asur laasot lah ken lefi sheenah tzericha: 
Keli shennitma meerev yom tov en matbilin oto beyom tov gezera shemma yashhe oto betumato. veim haya tzarich lehatebil mayim shebbo matbil et hakkeli bememav veeno choshesh. keli shehaya tahor litruma veratza lehatebilo lekodesh muttar lehatebilo. vechen kol kayyotze baze mittevilot maalot shear hattumot: 
Keli shennitma beyom tov matbilin oto beyom tov. nitma hakkeli bemashkin temein shehen velad hattuma meerev yom tov matbilin oto beyom tov lefi shehu tahor min hattora kemo sheyyitbaer bimkomo. umadlin bidli tame vehu tahor meelav. nidda sheen lah begadim lehachalif maaremet vetovelet bivgadeha: 
Devarim rabbim asru beyom tov mishshum gezerat mikkach umimkar. ketzad. en poskim damim lechattechilla al habbehema beyom tov ella mevi shete behemot shavot zo lazo veshochatin achat mehen umechallekin benehen ulemachar yodin kamma deme hashsheniyya vechol echad veechad noten deme chelko. keshehen mechallekin benehen lo yomar ze ani besela veatta bishnayim sheen mazkirin shum damim ella ze notel shelish veze revia: 
Keshehen mechallekin lo yishkelu bemoznayim sheen mashgichin bechaf moznayim kol ikkar. afillu litten bo basar leshamro min haachbarim asur im hayu hammoznayim teluyin mippene shennire keshokel bechaf moznayim. vetabbach umman asur lishkol beyado. veasur lishkol bichli male mayim. veen metilin challashim al hammanot. aval metilin challashim al besar hakkadashim beyom tov kede lechabbev et hammitzva: 
Lo yomar adam lattabbach ten li bedinar basar ella ten li chelek o chatzi chelek ulemachar osin cheshbon al shavyo. vechen lo yikkach mibbaal hachanut bemidda o bemishkal ella ketzad hu ose. omer lachenvani malle li keli ze ulemachar noten lo shavyo. vaafillu haya keli hameyuchad lemidda yemalleennu vehu shello yazkir lo shem midda: 
Hannachtom moded tavlin venoten lakkedera bishvil shello yafsid tavshilo. aval haishsha lo tamod kemach leissa. vechen lo yamod adam seorim litten lifne behemto ella meshaer venoten lah: 
Umuttar likkach min hachenvani betzim veegozim beminyan. vechen kol kayyotze bahen uvilvad shello yazkir lo shum damim velo sechum minyan. ketzad sechum hamminyan. hare shehaya noshe bo asara rimmonim o asara egozim lo yomar lo beyom tov ten li asara kede sheyyihye lecha esrim etzli ella lokeach setam ulemachar ose cheshbon: 
Holech adam etzel chenvani o roe haragil etzlo o etzel happattam haragil etzlo velokeach mimmennu behemot veofot vechol ma sheyyirtze vehu shello yazkir lo shum damim velo sechum minyan: 
Halevaat yom tov tovin otah bedin sheim tomar lo nittena lehittava eno noten lo kelum venimtza nimna missimchat yom tov: 
Af al pi sheen magbihin teruma umaasrot beyom tov im hayu lo terumot umaasrot shehigbihan meemesh hare ze molichan lakkohen beyom tov. veen tzarich lomar challa uzeroa ulechayayim vekeva shemmolichan lakkohen beyom tov. vegabbae tzedaka govin min hachatzerot beyom tov. velo yihyu machrizin kederech shemmachrizin bechol. ella govin betzina venotnin letoch chekan umechallekin lechol shechuna ushechuna bifne atzmah:
Mishneh Torah, Rest on a Holiday 5: Af al pi shehuttera hotzaa beyom tov afillu shello letzorech lo yissa massaot gedolot kederech shehu ose bechol ella tzarich leshannot. veim i efshar leshannot muttar. ketzad. hammevi kadde yayin mimmakom lemakom lo yeviem besal uvekuppa aval mevi hu al ketefo o lefanav. hammolich et hatteven lo yafshil et hakkuppa leacharav aval molichah beyado:

Vechen massoot sheddarkan lissa otan bemot yissa otan al gabbo meacharav. vesheddarkan lissa otan meachorav yissa otan al ketefo. vesheddarkan lehinnase al hakkatef yissa otan beyado lefanav o yifrosh alehen beged vechol kayyotze baze mishshinnuy hammassa. veim i efshar leshannot nose umevi kedarko. bamme devarim amurim benose al haadam aval al gabbe behema lo yavi kelal shello yaase kederech shehu ose bechol:

En manhigin et habbehema bemakkel. veen hassuma yotze bemaklo velo haroe betarmilo. veen yotzin bechisse echad haish veechad haishsha shello yaase kederech shehu ose bechol. vish shehayu rabbim tzerichin lo yotzin bechisse acharav umotziin oto al hakkatef afillu beappiryon:

En molichin et hassullam shel shovach mishshovach leshovach birshut harabbim shemma yomru letakken gaggo hu molicho. aval birshut hayyachid molicho. af al pi shekkol makom sheasru chachamim mippene marit haayin afillu bechadre chadarim asur kan hittiru mippene simchat yom tov:

Mi shehayu lo perot al gaggo vetzarich lefannotam lemakom acher lo yoshitem miggag legag vaafillu baggaggin hashshavin. velo yeshalshelem bechevel min hachallonot velo yoridem besullamot shello yaase kederech shehu ose bechol. aval mashshilan afillu derech arubba mimmakom lemakom beoto haggag. shachat behema bassade lo yevienna bemot lair o bemota aval meviah evarim evarim:

Kol shenneotin bo afillu bechol af al pi sheen neotin bo beyom tov kegon tefillin muttar leshalchan lachavero beyom tov. veen tzarich lomar davar shenneotin bo beyom tov kegon yenot shemanim uselatot shemmuttar leshalchan. vechol davar sheen neotin bo bechol ad sheyyaase bo maase sheasur laasoto beyom tov en meshallechin oto beyom tov:

Ketzad. en meshallechin beyom tov tevua lefi sheen neotin bah bechol ella im ken tachan veasur litchon beyom tov. aval meshallechin kitniyyot mippene shemmevashshelan beyom tov o kole otan veochlan. umeshallechin chayya behema veofot afillu chayyim mippene shemmuttar lishchot beyom tov. vechen kol kayyotze baze:

Kol davar shemmuttar leshalcho beyom tov kesheyyishlachennu lachavero teshura lo yishlachennu beshura veen shura pechuta mishshelosha bene adam. ketzad. hare sheshshalach lachavero behemot o yenot beyad shelosha bene adam keechad o arbaa ze achar ze vechullan holchin beshura achat hare ze asur shello yaase kederech shehu ose bechol. shalach shelosha minin beyad shelosha bene adam keechad hare ze muttar:
Hamearev eruve techumin leyom tov hare behemto vechelav uferotav kamohu. veen molichin otan ella betoch alpayim amma lechol ruach mimmekom eruvo:

Cheftze hefker hare hen keragle mi shezzacha bahen. vecheftze hakkutim konin shevita bimkoman veyesh lahen alpayim amma lechol ruach mimmekoman gezera bealim kutim mishshum bealim yisrael. perot sheyyatzu chutz limkoman vechazru afillu bemezid lo hifsidu et mekoman mippene shehen keadam sheyyatza beones vechazar beones:
Hammoser behemto livno hare hi keragle haav. mesarah leroe vaafillu netanah lo beyom tov hare hi keragle haroe. mesarah lishne roim hare hi keragle bealeha mippene shello kana echad mehen:

Mi shezzimmen etzlo orchim beyom tov lo yolichu beyadam manot lemakom sheen baal hasseudda yachol lelech bo. shekkol hasseudda keragle baal hasseudda lo keragle haorchin. ella im ken zacha lahen acher bemanot ellu meerev yom tov:

Vechen mi shehayu perotav mufkadin beir acheret veervu bene otah hair lavo etzlo lo yaviu lo mipperotav shepperotav kamohu af al pi shehen beyad ellu sheervu. bamme devarim amurim besheyyiched lahen keren zavit aval im lo yiched lahen hare hen keragle ze shehen mufkadin etzlo:

Bor shel yachid keragle bealav. veshel otah hair keragle anshe otah hair. veshel ole bavel shehen mesurin lakkol keragle hamemalle mehen shekkol mi shemmille mehen molichan lemakom shehu mehallech. neharot hammoshchin umaayanot hannovin keragle kol adam veim hayu bain michutz lattechum letoch hattechum memallein mehen beshabbat veen tzarich lomar beyom tov:

Shor shel roe keragle anshe otah hair. veshor shel petam keragle mi shellekacho leshochoto beyom tov. mippene sheddaat bealav lemachro laanashim acherim chutz meanshe otah hair mippene shehu mefuttam vehakkol shomin shamo uvain liknoto. vechen im shechato bealav beyom tov umachar besaro. kol echad veechad min hallokchim molich menato lemakom shehu holech mippene sheddaat bealav meerev yom tov kach hu sheyyikchu mimmennu anshe ayarot acherot venimtza shor ze kevor shel ole bavel shehu masur lakkol:
Haggachelet keragle bealeha lo keragle shoalah vehashshalhevet keragle mi shehi beyado. lefichach hammadlik ner o etz mechavero molicho lechol makom shehu holech:

Hashshoel keli mechavero meerev yom tov af al pi shello netano lo ella beyom tov hare hu keragle hashshoel. shealo mimmennu beyom tov af al pi sheddarko tamid lishl mimmennu keli ze bechol yom tov hare hu keragle hammashil:

Shenayim sheshshaalu chaluk echad haechad shealo mimmennu sheyyitteno lo shacharit vehashsheni shealo mimmennu sheyyitteno lo arvit hare keli ze keragle shene hashshoalim veenam molichim oto ella bemakom sheshshenehem yecholin lehallech bo:

Ketzad. hare sheerev harishon berichuk elef amma mimmekom hechaluk lemizrach veerev hashsheni berichuk chamesh meot amma mimmekom hechaluk lammaarav. keshellokeach harishon hechaluk eno molicho lammizrach ella ad elef amma vachamesh meot amma mimmekom hechaluk shehu sof hattechum sheyyachol ze sheerev bammaarav lehallech bo. uchesheyyikkach hashsheni keli ze eno molicho bammaarav ella ad elef amma mimmekom hakkeli shehu sof hattechum sheyyachol ze sheerev bammizrach lehallech bo. lefichach im erev ze berichuk alpayim amma min hechaluk lammizrach veze berichuk alpayim amma lammaarav hare ellu lo yezizuhu mimmekomo:

Vechen haishsha sheshshaala mechavertah mayim o melach velasha bahen issatah o bishshela bahen tavshil hare haissa o hattavshil keragle shetehen. vechen shenayim shellakchu behema beshuttafut veshachatu beyom tov af al pi shellakach kol echad menato hare kol habbasar keragle shenehen. aval im lakchu chavit beshuttafut vechalku otah beyom tov hare chelko shel kol echad keraglav. hoil utechumin middivre sofrim yesh berera bahen venachshov keillu chelek shehiggia laze haya barur lo umuvdal bechavit meerev yom tov ucheillu lo haya meorav. veen atta yachol lomar ken bivhema shechelek ze shehiggio afillu nachshov oto shehaya muvdal bivhema meerev yom tov ucheillu haya barur hare yanak mechelko shel chavero keshehayta habbehema kayyemet shekkol evareha yonkin ze mizze venimtza kol evar veevar meorav mechelko vechelek chavero. lefichach hen keragle shenehen:
Mishneh Torah, Rest on a Holiday 6:
Yom tov shechal lihyot erev shabbat en ofin umevashshelin beyom tov ma shehu ochel lemachar beshabbat. veissur ze middivre sofrim kede shello yavo levashshel miyyom tov lechol. shekkal vachomer hu leshabbat eno mevashshel kol shekken lechol. lefichach im asa tavshil meerev yom tov sheyyihye somech alav umevashshel veofe beyom tov leshabbat hare ze muttar. vetavshil shessomech alav hu hannikra eruve tavshilin: 
Velamma nikra shemo eruv. shekkeshem shehaeruv sheosin bachatzerot umevoot meerev shabbat mishshum hekker kede shello yaale al datam shemmuttar lehotzi mershut lirshut beshabbat. kach ze hattavshil mishshum hekker vezikkaron kede shello yedammu veyachshevu shemmuttar leefot beyom tov ma sheeno neechol bo bayyom. ulefichach nikra tavshil ze eruve tavshilin: 
Eruve tavshilin shiuro en pachot mikkezayit ben leechad ben laalafim. veen osin eruv ze lo befat velo berifot vechayyotze bahen ella betavshil shehu parperet kegon basar vedagim uvetzim vechayyotze bahen. vaafillu adashim shebbeshule kedera vaafillu shamnunit sheal gabbe hassakkin shechotchin bah hatztzali gordo im yesh bo kezayit somech alav mishshum eruve tavshilin: 
Tavshil sheamru leinyan eruv ze afillu tzali afillu shaluk afillu kavush o meeshshan afillu dagim ketannim shehedichan bemayim chammin vahadachatan hi bishshulan laachila hare ze somech alehen: 
Vetzarich sheyyihye eruv ze matzuy ad sheyyofe kol ma shehu tzarich leefot ulevashshel kol shehu tzarich levashshel. veyachem chammin kol shehu tzarich. veim neechal haeruv o avad o nisraf kodem sheyyevashshel o yofe hare ze asur leefot ulevashshel o lehachem ella ma shehu ochel beyom tov bilvad. hitchil beissato o betavshilo veneechal haeruv o avad hare ze gomer: 
Hammeniach eruve tavshilin kede sheyyismoch alehem hu vaacherim tzarich lezakkot lahen kederech shemmezakke beeruve shabbat. vechol shezzoche beeruve shabbat zoche beeruve tavshilin. vechol sheeno zoche beoto eruv eno zoche baze: 
Veeno tzarich lehodia leellu shezzikka lahen meerev yom tov. aval hen tzerichin leda shekkevar zikka lahen acher veerev lahen veachar kach yismechu alav vivashshelu veyofu. af al pi shello yadu ella beyom tov hare ellu muttarin. veyesh lo leadam learev al kol hair veal kol hakkarov eleha betoch hattechum ulemachar machriz veomer kol mi shello hinniach eruve tavshilin yismoch al eruvi: 
Hammanniach eruve tavshilin chayyav levarech. baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam asher kiddeshanu bemitzvotav vetzivvanu al mitzvat eruv. veomer beeruv ze yuttar li leefot ulevashshel miyyom tov shellemachar leshabbat. veim zacha bo laacherim yomar li velifloni velifloni o leanshe hair kullam leefot ulevashshel miyyom tov leshabbat: 
Mi shello hinniach eruve tavshilin velo hinnichu lo acherim. keshem sheasur lo levashshel veleefot kach kimcho umaachalo asur. veasur leacher shehinniach leatzmo levashshel veleefot laze shello hinniach ad sheyyakne lo shennimtza ze mevashshel veofe shello shehare kanahu. veim ratza yitten achar kach laze shello hinniach bemattana: 
Mi shello hinniach eruve tavshilin uvishshel veafa leechol bayyom vehotir o shezzimmen orchim velo bau hare ze ochel hammotar lemachar. veim heerim hare ze asur leachlo. avar veafa uvishshel leshabbat en osrin alav. velamma hechmiru veasru al hammaarim velo asru al hammezid sheim tattir lammaarim nimtzeu hakkol maarimin veyishtakkea shem eruve tavshilin. aval hammezid eno matzuy veim avar hayyom lo yaavor paam acheret: 
Shene yamim tovim shechalu lihyot bachamishi veerev shabbat ose eruve tavshilin miyyom revii shehu erev yom tov. shachach velo hinniach mannicho barishon umatne. ketzad. manniach eruve tavshilin beyom chamishi veomer im hayyom yom tov ulemachar chol lemachar avashshel veofe leshabbat veeni tzarich kelum veim hayyom chol ulemachar yom tov baeruv ze yettar li leefot ulevashshel lemachar miyyom tov leshabbat: 
Kayyotze bo hayu lefanav shete kalkalot shel tevel beyom tov rishon omer im hayyom chol tihye zo teruma al zo veim hayyom kodesh en bidvaray kelum. vekore aleha shem umannichah. ulemachar bashsheni chozer veomer im hayyom kodesh en bidvaray kelum veim hayyom chol tihye zo teruma al zo vekore aleha shem umannichah kederech shekkara aleha barishon. umanniach et zo shekkara aleha shem teruma veochel et hashsheniyya: 
Bamme devarim amurim bishne yamim tovim shel galuyyot aval bishne yamim tovim shel rosh hashshana im shachach velo hinniach beyom revii shuv eno manniach ella somech al acherim im ervu alav o makne kimcho lemi sheerev o yihye asur leefot ulevashshel leshabbat. vechen im shachach velo hifrish teruma miyyom revii shuv eno mafrish ad motzae shabbat: 
Kol haddevarim haellu sheamarnu hayu bizman shehayu bet din shel eretz yisrael mekaddeshin al pi hariyya vehayu bene haggaluyyot osin shene yamim kede lehistallek min hassafek lefi shello hayu yodin yom shekkiddeshu bene eretz yisrael. aval hayyom shebbene eretz yisrael somchin al hacheshbon umekaddeshin alav en yom tov sheni lehistallek min hassafek ella minhag bilvad: 
Ulefichach ani omer sheen mearev adam umatne bazzeman hazze lo eruve tavshilin velo eruve chatzerot velo shittufe mevoot veeno measser hattevel al tenay ella hakkol meerev yom tov bilvad: 
Keshem shemmitzva lechabbed shabbat uleannegah kach kol yamim tovim shenneemar <small>(yeshaya noach 13)</small> "likdosh Adonai mechubbad" vechol yamim tovim neemar bahen <small>(Vayikra 23 7)</small> "mikra kodesh". uchevar bearnu hakkibbud vehainnug behilchot shabbat. vechen rauy leadam shello yisod bearve yamim tovim min hammincha ulemala keerev shabbat sheddavar ze bichlal hakkavod. vechol hamevazze et hammoadot keillu nitpal laavodat kochavim: 
Shivat yeme happesach ushemonat yeme hechag im shear yamim tovim kullam asurim behesped vetaanit. vechayyav adam lihyot bahen sameach vetov lev hu uvanav veishto uvene beto vechol hannilvim alav shenneemar <small>(Devarim 16 14)</small> "vesamachta bechaggecha" vegomer. af al pi shehassimcha haamura kan hi karban shelamim kemo sheanu mevaarin behilchot chagiga yesh bichlal otah simcha lismoach hu uvanav uvene beto kol echad karauy lo: 
Ketzad. hakketannim noten lahem kelayot veegozim umigdanot. vehannashim kone lahen begadim vetachshitin naim kefi mamono. vehaanashim ochlin basar veshotin yayin sheen simcha ella bevasar veen simcha ella beyayin. ucheshehu ochel veshote chayyav lehaachil lagger layyatom velaalmana im shear haaniyyim haumlalim. aval mi shennoel daltot chatzero veochel veshote hu uvanav veishto veeno maachil umashke laaniyyim ulemare nefesh en zo simchat mitzva ella simchat kereso. veal ellu neemar <small>(Hoshea 9 4)</small> "zivchehem kelechem onim lahem kol ochlav yittammau ki lachmam lenafsham". vesimcha kazo kalon hi lahem shenneemar <small>(Malachi 2 3)</small> "vezeriti feresh al penechem peresh chaggechem": 
Af al pi sheachila ushetiyya bammoadot bichlal mitzvat ase. lo yihye ochel veshote kol hayyom kullo. ella kach hi haddat. babboker mashkimin kol haam levatte kenesiyyot ulevatte midrashot umitpallelin vekorin battora beinyan hayyom vechozrin levattehem veochlin. veholchin levatte midrashot korin veshonin ad chatzi hayyom. veachar chatzot hayyom mitpallelin tefillat hammincha vechozrin levattehen leechol velishtot shear hayyom ad hallayla: 
Kesheadam ochel veshote vesameach baregel lo yimmashech beyayin uvischok vekallut rosh veyomar shekkol mi sheyyosif baze yarbe bemitzvat simcha. shehashshichrut vehassechok harabba vekallut harosh enah simcha ella hollut vesichlut velo nitztavvenu al hahollut vehassichlut ella al hassimcha sheyyesh bah avodat yotzer hakkol shenneemar <small>(Devarim 28 47)</small> "tachat asher lo avadta et Adonai elohecha besimcha uvetuv levav merov kl". ha lamadta shehaavoda besimcha. vei efshar laavod et hashshem lo mittoch sechok velo mittoch kallut rosh velo mittoch shichrut: 
Chayyavin bet din lehaamid shotrim bargalim sheyyihyu mesabbevin umechappesin baggannot uvappardesim veal hanneharot kede shello yitkabbetzu leechol velishtot sham anashim venashim veyavou lide avera. vechen yazhiru bedavar ze lechol haam kede shello yitarvu anashim venashim bevattehem lesimcha. velo yimmashchu bayyayin shemma yavou lide avera: 
Yamim shebben rishon ushevii shel pesach verishon ushemini shel chag hassukkot vehen baggola arbaa betoch happesach vachamishsha betoch hechag hem hannikrain chullo shel moed venikrain moed. veaf al pi shehem chayyavin besimcha vaasurin behesped vetaanit muttar lispod bahen talmid chacham befanav. aval leachar sheyyikkaver asur lesafdo bahen. veen tzarich lomar berashe chodashim bachanukka uvefurim shessofdin bahen talmide chachamim befanav af al pi sheyyamim ellu asurin behesped vetaanit. aval leachar hakkevura asur lispod bahen: 
En mannichin mittat hammet barchov bammoed shello leharegil et hahesped ella mibbeto lekivro. veen mitabbelin bammoed. vechen en korin velo mavrin velo choltzin hakkatef bammoed al hammet ella kerovav shehen chayyavin lehitabbel alav. veim haya chacham o adam kasher o shehaya omed alav bishat netilat neshama hare ze korea alav bammoed af al pi sheeno kerovo. veen korin beyom tov sheni kelal vaafillu kerovav shel met: 
Nashim bammoed bifne hammet meannot aval lo metappechot velo mekonnot. nikbar hammet enan meannot. berashe chodashim vachanukka ufurim bifne hammet meannot umetappechot aval lo mekonnot. e zehu innuy shekkullan onot keachat. kina achat omeret vechullan onot. veasur leadam sheyyeorer al meto kodem laregel sheloshim yom kede shello yavo haregel vehu neetzav velibbo doeg vechoev mizzichron hatztzaar ella yasir haddeaga millibbo vichavven dato lesimcha:
Mishneh Torah, Rest on a Holiday 7: Chulo shel moed af al pi shello neemar bo <small>(Vayikra 23 24)</small> <small>(Vayikra 23 39)</small> "shabbaton" hoil venikra <small>(Vayikra 23 7)</small> "mikra kodesh" vahare hu zeman chagiga bammikdash asur baasiyyat melacha kede shello yihye kishar yeme hachol sheen bahen kedushsha kelal. vehaose bo melacha haasura makkin oto makkat mardut mippene sheissuro middivre sofrim. velo kol melechet avoda asura bo keyom tov shessof hainyan baddevarim shenneesru bo kede shello yihye keyom chol lechol davar. lefichach yesh melachot asurot bo veyesh melachot muttarot bo:

Veellu hen. kol melacha sheim lo yaase otah bammoed yihye sham hefsed harebe osin otah. uvilvad shello yihye bah torach harebe. ketzad. mashkin bet hashshelachin bammoed aval lo bet hammashke. sheim lo yashke bet hashshelachin vehi haaretz hatztzemea yippasdu bo hailanot shebbah. ucheshehu mashke otah lo yidle veyashke min habberecha o mimme haggeshamim mippene shehu torach gadol. aval mashke hu min hammayan ben shehaya ben sheyyatza lechattechilla mamshicho umashke bo. vechen kol kayyotze baze:

Hofech adam et zetav bammoed vetochen otan vedorech otan umemalle hechaviyyot vegaf otan kederech shehu ose bechol. kol sheyyesh bo hefsed im lo naasa osehu kedarko veeno tzarich shinnuy. vechen machnis adam perotav mippene haggannavim uvilvad sheyyachnisem betzina. veshole pishtano min hammishre bishvil shello tovad. vechen kerem shehiggia zemanno lehibbatzer bammoed botzrin oto:

Veasur laadam sheyyitkavven viacher melachot ellu vechayyotze bahen veyannichem kede laasotan bammoed mippene shehu panuy. vechol hamechavven melachto vehinnichah lammoed vaasaah bammoed bet din meabbedin otah umafkirin otah lakkol. veim kivven melachto umet en konsin beno acharav veen meabbedin otah mimmennu. veen monin habben millaasot otah melacha bammoed kede shello tovad:

Mi shetztzarach litpor lo beged o livnot lo makom bammoed. im haya hedyot veeno mahir beotah melacha hare ze ose otah kedarko. veim haya umman mahir hare ze ose otah maase hedyot. ketzad. bitfira machliv uvevinyan manniach avanim veeno tach betit alehen veshaf sidke hakkarka umaagilah bayyad uvaregel keen shemmaagilim bemachlatzayim. vechen kol kayyotze baze:

Mi shehayta lo tevua mechubberet lakkarka veen lo ma sheyyochal bammoed ella mimmenna af al pi sheen kan hefsed en matzrichin oto liknot ma sheyyochal min hashshuk ad sheyyiktzor achar hammoed ella kotzer umeammer vedash vezore uvorer vetochen ma shehu tzarich. uvilvad shello yadush befarot. shekkol davar sheen bo hefsed tzarich leshannot. vechen kol kayyotze baze:

Kevashim sheyyachol leechol mehen bammoed kovshan. vesheenan reuyin ella leachar hammoed asur lechavshan. vetzad adam dagim kol sheyyachol latzud umoleach hakkol bammoed shehare efshar sheyyochal mehen bammoed im yischot otan beyado peamim rabbot ad sheyyitrakkechu:

Metilin shechar bammoed letzorech hammoed. veshello letzorech hammoed asur. echad shechar temarim veechad shechar seorim. af al pi sheyyesh lo yashan maarim veshote min hechadash sheen haarama zo nikkeret laroe. vechen kol kayyotze baze:

Kol melachot shehen letzorech hammoed kesheosin otan ummanehen osin betzina. ketzad. hatztzayyadim vehattochanin vehabbotzrin limkor bashshuk hare ellu osin betzina letzorech hammoed. veim asa letzorech hammoed vehotir hare ze muttar:

Osin kol tzarche harabbim bammoed. ketzad. metakkenim kilkule hammayim shebbirshut harabbim. umetakkenin et hadderachim veet harchovot. vechofrim larabbim borot shichin umearot. vechorin lahen neharot kede sheyyishtu memehen vechonsim mayim levorot umearot shel rabbim umetakkenin et sidkehen. umesirin et hakkotzin min hadderachim. umoddin et hammikvaot vechol mikve shennimtza chaser margilin lo mayim umashlimin lo shiuro:

Veyotzin sheluche bet din lehafekir et hakkilayim. ufodin et hashshevuyim veet haerchin veet hacharamim veet hahekdeshot. umashkin et hassotot. vesorfin et happara. veorfin et haegla. verotzin eved ivri. umetaharin et hametzora. umetzayyenin al hakkevarot shemmichu geshamim et tziyyunan kede sheyyifreshu mehen hakkohanim. shekkol ellu tzarche rabbim hen:

Vedanim dine mamonot vedine makkot vedine nefashot bammoed. umi shello kibbel alav haddin meshammetin oto bammoed. ucheshem sheddanin bammoed kach kotvin maase bet din vechol haddome lo. ketzad. kotvin haddayyanin iggerot shum sheshshamu levaal chov veiggerot shemmachru bahen limzon haishsha vehabbanot. veshitre chalitza umeunin. vechol haddome lahen middevarim shetztzerichim haddayyanin lechatvam kede sheyyizkerum. kegon taanot baale dinin o devarim shekkibbelu alehen kegon ish peloni neeman alay. o ish peloni yadun li. mi shetztzarich lilvot bammoed velo heemino hammalve beal pe hare ze kotev shetar chov. vechen kotvin gittin vekiddushe nashim veshovrin umattanot. shekkol ellu ketzarche rabbim hen:

Veasur lichtov bammoed afillu sefarim tefillin umezuzot. veen maggihin afillu ot achat besefer haazara mippene shezzo melacha sheenah letzorech hammoed. aval kotev adam tefillin umezuza leatzmo vetove techelet levigdo. veim en lo ma yochal kotev umocher laacherim kede parnasato:
Umuttar lichtov iggerot shel sheelat shalom bammoed. vechotev cheshbonotav umechashshev yetziotav. shekketivot ellu en adam nizhar betikkunan meod venimtzeu kemaase hedyot bimlachot:

Osin kol tzarche hammet bammoed. gozzin searo umechabbesin kesuto veosin lo aron. veim lo hayu lahem nesarim meviin korot venosrin mehem nesarim betzina betoch habbayit. veim haya adam mefursam osin afillu bashshuk. aval en kortin etz min hayyaar linsor mimmennu luchot laaron. veen chotzvin avanim livnot bahen kever:

En roin et hannegaim bammoed shemma yimmatze tame venimtza chaggo nehefach leevel. veen nosin nashim velo meyabbemin bammoed kede shello tishtakkeach simchat hechag besimchat hannissuin. aval machazir et gerushato. umearsin nashim bammoed. uvilvad shello yaase seuddat erusin velo seuddat nissuin. shello yearev simcha acheret besimchat hechag:

En megallechin veen mechabbesin bammoed gezera shemma yashhe adam atzmo letoch hammoed veyavo yom tov harishon vehu menuvval. lefichach kol mi shei efshar lo legalleach ulechabbes beerev yom tov hare ze muttar lechabbes ulegalleach bammoed:

Ketzad. avel shechal shevii shello lihyot beyom tov o shechal lihyot beerev yom tov vahare hu shabbat shei efshar legalleach. vehabba mimmedinat hayyam vehu shello yatza lehitayyel ella lischora vechayyotze bah. vehayyotze mibbet hashshivya umibbet haasurim. umi shehaya menudde velo hittiruhu ella bammoed. umi shennishba shello legalleach veshello lechabbes velo nishal lechacham lehattir nidro ella bammoed hare ellu megallechin umechabbesin bammoed:

Vechullan shehaya lahen penay legalleach kodem haregel velo gillechu asurin. aval hannazir vehametzora shehiggia zeman tiglachtan ben betoch hammoed ben kodem haregel af al pi shehaya lahem penay muttarin legalleach bammoed shello yashhu karbenotehen. vechol hayyotze mittumato letohorato muttar legalleach bammoed. vekatan shennolad ben bammoed ben lifne hammoed muttar legallecho bammoed. veanshe mishmar sheshshalma mishmartan betoch hammoed muttarin legalleach mippene sheanshe mishmar asurin legalleach beshabbat shellahen:

Muttar littol safa bechullo shel moed. velittol tzipparnayim vaafillu bichli. umaaveret haishsha sear mibbet hashshechi umibbet haerva ben bayyad ben bichli. veosa kol tachshiteha bammoed. kochelet ufokeset umaaveret serak al paneha vetofelet atzmah besid vechayyotze bo vehu shettuchal lekappelo bammoed:

Hazzavim vehazzavot vehanniddot vehayyoldot vechol haolim mittuma letohora betoch hammoed hare ellu muttarin lechabbes. umi sheen lo ella chaluk echad hare ze mechabbeso bammoed. mitpechot hayyadayim umitpechot hassefarim umitpechot hasefag hare ellu muttarin lechabbes bammoed. vechen kele pishtan muttar lechabbesan bammoed mippene shetztzerichin kibbus tamid afillu nitkabbesu erev yom tov:

En osin sechora bammoed ben limkor ben liknot. veim haya davar haaved sheeno matzuy tamid leachar hammoed kegon sefinot o shayyarot shebbau o shehem mevakkeshim latzet umachru bezol o lakchu beyoker hare ze muttar liknot o limkor. veen lokchin battim vaavadim uvehema ella letzorech hammoed:

Mochre perot kesut vechelim mochrin betzina letzorech hammoed. ketzad. im hayta hachanut petucha lezavit o lemavoy poteach kedarko. veim hayta petucha lirshut harabbim poteach achat venoel achat. veerev yom tov haacharon shel chag hassukkot motzi umeatter et hashshuk beferot bishvil kevod yom tov. mochre tavlin mochrin kedarkan befarhesya:

Kol sheasur laasoto bammoed eno omer lenachri laasoto. vechol sheasur laasoto bammoed im en lo ma sheyyochal hare ze ose kede parnasato. vechen ose sechora kede parnasato. umuttar leashir liskor poel ani sheen lo ma yochal laasot melacha shehi asura bammoed kede sheyyittol secharo lehitparnes bo. vechen lokchin devarim sheenam letzorech hammoed mippene tzorech hammocher sheen lo ma yochal:

Sochrin hassachir al hammelacha bammoed laasotah leachar hammoed uvilvad shello yishkol veshello yimdod velo yimne kederech shehu ose bechol. nachri shekkibbel kibbolet miyyisrael afillu haya chutz lattechum eno mannicho laasoto bammoed. shehakkol yodin shemmelacha zo shel yisrael veyachshedu oto shehu sachar et hannachri laasot lo bammoed. sheen hakkol yodin hahefresh sheyyesh ben hassachir uven hakkabbelan ulefichach asur:
Mishneh Torah, Rest on a Holiday 8: Neharot hammoshchin min haagammim muttar lehashekot mehen bet hashshelachin bammoed vehu shello pasku. vechen habberechot sheammat hammayim overet benehen muttar lehashekot mehen. vechen berecha shennatfa mibbet hashshelachin vaadayin hi notefet muttar lehashekot mimmenna bet hashshelachin acheret. vehu shello pasak hammayan hammashke bet hashshelachin haelyona:

Aruga shechetzyah namuch vechetzyah gavoah lo yidle mimmakom namuch lehashekot makom gavoah mippene shehu torach gadol. umuttar lidlot mayim lehashekot hayerakot kede leachlan bammoed. veim bishvil leyappotan asur:

En osin ugiyyot beikkere haggefanim kede sheyyitmalleu mayim. veim hayu asuyot venitkalkelu hare ze metakkenam bammoed. vechen ammat hammayim shennitkalkela metakkenin otah bammoed. ketzad. hayta amukka tefach chofer bah ad shishsha. hayta amukka tefachayim maamikah ad shiva. umoshchin et hammayim meilan leilan uvilvad shello yashke et kol hassade. veim hayta sade lacha muttar lehashekot et kullah. umarbitzin et hassade bammoed. shekkol haddevarim haellu en bahen torach yoter:

Zeraim shello shatu millifne hammoed lo yashkem bammoed mippene shehen tzerichin mayim rabbim veyavo lide torach yoter. umuttar lehasev et hannahar mimmakom lemakom veliftoach nahar shennistam. borot shichin umearot shel yachid im haya tzarich lahem chottin otan veshafin et sidkehem aval en chofrin otan lechattechilla. vechonsim letochah mayim af al pi sheeno tzarich lahen. veosin nivrechet bammoed:

Achbarim shehen mafsidin et hailanot tzadin otan bammoed. bisde hailan tzad kedarko. ketzad. chofer vetole hammetzuda. veim haya sade lavan samuch lisde hailan tzadin otan bassade hallavan beshinnuy kede shello yikkansu lisde hailan veyachrivuha. vechetzad tzad, beshinnuy. noetz shippud baaretz umakke bekordom veachar kach menatteko venimtza mekomo guma:

Kotel ginna shennafal bonehu maase hedyot o goder oto bekanim vegome vechayyotze bahen. vechen im asa maake laggag bone oto maase hedyot. aval kotel chatzer shennafal bonehu kedarko. veim haya gohe sotro mippene hassakkana uvonehu kedarko:

Bone adam itztabba leshev o lishon aleha. hatztzir vehatztzinnor vehakkora vehammanul vehammafteach shennishberu metakkenan bammoed kedarko ben beshel barzel ben beshel etz. shezze hefsed gadol hu sheim yaniach happetach patuach udelatot shevurot nimtza meabbed kol ma shebbabbayit. uchevar bearnu kol sheyyesh bo hefsed eno tzarich shinnuy:
En chofrin kever lihyot muchan lemet sheyyamut veen bonin oto. aval im haya asuy hare ze metakkeno bammoed. ketzad. mosif bemiddato o mekatztzer mimmiddato kede sheyyihye nachon leet sheyyikbor bo:

En mefannin et hammet velo et haatzamot mikkever lekever lo mimmechubbad levazuy velo mibbazuy limchubbad. veasur laasot ken leolam bishar hayyamim ella im ken haya mefannehu betoch shello mefannehu bishar hayyamim afillu mimmechubbad levazuy:

En matliin et hailanot velo mazhimin et hannetiot velo megazzemin. aval sachin et hailanot veet happerot shebbahen beshemen veokrin et happishta mippene shehi reuya lachafof bah bammoed. vekotzrin et hakkishshut mippene shehi reuya lehattilah leshechar bammoed. vechen kol kayyotze baze:

En mechannesin et hatztzon laddir kede sheyyezabbelu et hakkarka. shehare hu medayyer sadehu bammoed. veim bau mealehen muttar. veen mesayyein otan veen mosrin lahen shomer lenaer et hatztzon. haya sechir shabbat sechir chodesh sechir shana sechir shavua mesayyein otan vesochrin shomer lenaer et tzonam mimmakom lemakom kede sheyyezabbelu kol hassade. hazzevel shebbechatzer mesallekin oto latztzedadin. veim naasa chatzer kerefet bakar motziin oto laashpa:

Hammashve pene hakkarka im nitkavven letakken makom sheyyaamid bo keri shel tevua o sheyyadush bo muttar. veim nitkavven laavodat haaretz asur. vechen hamelakket etzim mittoch sadehu im letzorech etzim muttar veim letakken hakkarka asur. vechen happotek mayim leginna im nitkavven sheyyikkansu haddagim muttar veim lehashekot haaretz asur. vechen hakkotzetz charayot min haddekel im nitkavven lehaachil labbehema muttar veim nitkavven laavodat hailan asur. umimmaasav yukkar lee ze davar hu mitkavven:

Tannur vechirayim sheefshar sheyivshu veyofe bahen bammoed osin veim lav en osin otan. vben kach uven kach bonin al cheres shel tannur veal hikkira hattefela shellahen umesargin et hammittot. venokrin et harechayim ufotchim lahen ayin umaamidin otan uvonin ammat hammayim shel rechayim:

Zoftin et hechavit kede shello yippased hayyayin. vezoftin et habbakbuk mippene sheen bo torach. vesotmin pi hechavit shel shechar kede shello tippased. umechappin et hakketziot bekash kede shello yovdu. umerakkechin et habbegadim bayyadayim. mippene shehu maase hedyot. aval en osin kishre bet hayyadayim mippene shehu maase umman. vechen kol kayyotze baze:

Kotztzin tzipparne chamor shel rechayim uvonin evus labbehema. vesus sheyyirkav alav muttar littol tzipparnav ulesarko kede leyappoto. veen marbiin behema bammoed. aval makkizin lah dam. veen monin mimmenna refua. vechol maachalot umashkim sheenan maachal beriim ella lirfua muttar laadam leachlan velishtotan bammoed:

En mefannin mechatzer lechatzer bammoed. velo mikkeura lenaa velo minnaa lichura. aval mefanne hu mibbayit levayit beotah chatzer. umeviin kelim shehen letzorech hammoed mibbet haumman. kegon karim uchesatot utzelochiyyot. aval kelim sheenan letzorech hammoed kegon machresha min hallotesh o tzemer mibbet hatztzabba en meviin. veim en laumman ma yochal noten lo secharo umannichan etzlo. veim eno maamino mannichan babbayit hassamuch lo. veim choshesh lahem shemma yigganvu mefannan lechatzer acheret aval lo yavi leveto ella betzina:

Asur laasot melacha bearve yamim tovim min hammincha ulemala kemo arve shabbatot. vechol haose melacha bahen eno roe siman beracha leolam. vegoarin bo umevattelin oto beal karcho. aval en makkin oto makkat mardut. veen tzarich lomar sheen menaddin oto. chutz meerev happesach achar chatzot shehaose bo melacha achar chatzot menaddin oto. veen tzarich lomar shemmakkin oto makkat mardut im lo nidduhu. lefi sheyyom arbaa asar benisan eno kishar arve yamim tovim mippene sheyyesh bo chagiga ushechitat karban:

Lefichach yom arbaa asar benisan asur baasiyyat melacha middivre sofrim kemo chullo shel moed. vehu kal mechullo shel moed. veeno asur ella mechatzi hayyom ulemala shehu zeman hashshechita. aval mehanetz hachamma ad chatzi hayyom taluy bamminhag. makom shennahagu laasot osin makom shennahagu shello laasot en osin:

Vaafillu bemakom shennahagu laasot lo yatchil battechilla laasot melacha bearbaa asar af al pi shehu yachol legamrah kodem chatzot. ella shalosh ummanuyyot bilvad hen shemmatchilin bahem bemakom shennahagu laasot veosin ad chatzot. veellu hen hachayyatin. vehassapparin. vehakkovsin. aval shear ummanuyyot im hitchil bahen kodem arbaa asar hu sheyyigmor ad chatzot sheen haam tzerichin lishar ummanuyyot tzorech harebe:

Haholech mimmakom sheosin lemakom sheen osin lo yaase bayyishshuv mippene hammachaloket aval ose hu bammidbar. vehaholech mimmakom sheen osin lemakom sheosin lo yaase. notnin alav chumre makom sheyyatza mishsham vechumre makom shehalach lesham. veaf al pi chen lo yitrae bifnehem shehu batel mippene haissur. leolam al yeshanne adam mippene hammachaloket. vechen mi sheddato lachazor limkomo noheg keanshe mekomo ben lehakel ben lehachamir. vehu shello yitrae bifne anshe hammakom shehu bo mippene hammachaloket:

Molichin umeviin kelim mibbet haumman bearbaa asar achar chatzot af al pi sheenan letzorech hammoed. vegorfin zevel mittachat ragle behema umotziim oto laashpa. umoshivin shovachin lattarnegolim. tarnegolet sheyyashva al habbetzim shelosha yamim o yeter umeta moshivin acheret tachteha bearbaa asar kede shello yippasdu habbetzim. uvammoed en moshivin. aval im barcha bammoed meal habbetzim machzirin otah limkomah: seliku lehu hilchot shevitat yom tov
Mishneh Torah, Rest on the Tenth of Tish: Mitzvat ase lishbot mimmelacha beasor lachodesh hashshevii shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 23 32)</small> "shabbat shabbaton hu lachem". vechol haose bo melacha bittel mitzvat ase veavar al lo taase shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 29 7)</small> "uveasor" vegomer <small>(Bamidbar 29 7)</small> "kol melacha lo taasu". uma hu chayyav al asiyyat melacha beyom ze. im asa birtzono bezadon chayyav karet. veim asa bishgaga chayyav karban chattat kevua:

Kol melacha shechayyavin al zedonah beshabbat sekila chayyavin al zedonah beasor karet. vechol shechayyavin alav karban chattat beshabbat chayyavin alav karban chattat beyom hakkippurim. vechol davar sheasur laasoto beshabbat af al pi sheeno melacha asur laasoto beyom hakkippurim. veim asa makkin oto makkat mardut kederech shemmakkin oto al hashshabbat. vechol sheasur letaltelo beshabbat asur letaltelo beyom hakkippurim. vechol sheasur leamro o laasoto lechattechilla beshabbat kach asur beyom hakkippurim. kelalo shel davar en ben shabbat leyom hakkippurim beinyanim ellu ella shezzedon melacha beshabbat biskila uveyom hakkippurim becharet:

Umuttar lekannev et hayyarak beyom hakkippurim min hammincha ulemala. umahu hakkinuv sheyyasir et healim hameuppashot vikatztzetz hashshear vitakken oto laachila. vechen mefatztzein beegozin umefarchin berimmonim min hammincha ulemala mippene agmat nefesh. veyom hakkippurim shechal lihyot beshabbat asur biknivat yarak uviftziat egozim uvifrichat rimmonim kol hayyom. uchevar nahagu haam beshinar uvammaarav shello yaasu achat mikkol ellu beyom hatztzom ella hare hu keshabbat lechol devarav:

Mitzvat ase acheret yesh beyom hakkippurim vehi lishbot bo meachila ushetiyya shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 16 29)</small> "teannu et nafshotechem". mippi hashshemua lamdu e ze hu innuy shehu lannefesh ze hatztzom. vechol hatztzam bo kiyyem mitzvat ase. vechol haochel veshote bo bittel mitzvat ase veavar al lo taase shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 23 29)</small> "ki chol hannefesh asher lo teunne beetzem hayyom hazze venichreta". meachar sheanash hakkatuv karet lemi shello nitanna lamadnu shemmuzharin anu bo al achila ushetiyya. vechol haochel o hashshote bo beshogeg chayyav karban chattat kevua:

Vechen lamadnu mippi hashshemua sheasur lirchotz bo o lasuch o linol et hassandal o livol. umitzva lishbot mikkol ellu kederech sheshshovet maachila ushetiyya shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 16 lo)</small> <small>(Vayikra 23 32)</small> shabbat shabbaton shabbat leinyan (achila) veshabbaton leinyanim ellu. veen chayyavin karet o karban ella al achila ushetiyya. aval im rachatz o sach o naal o baal makkin oto makkat mardut:

Keshem sheshshevut melacha bo ben bayyom uven ballayla kach shevut leinnuy ben bayyom ben ballayla. vetzarich lehosif mechol al hakkodesh bichnisato uvitziato shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 23 32)</small> "veinnitem et nafshotechem betisha lachodesh baerev". kelomar hatechel latzum ulehitannot meerev tisha hassamuch laasiri. vechen baytzia shoha beinnuyo meat millel achad asar samuch laasiri shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 23 32)</small> "meerev vead erev tishbetu shabbattechem":

Nashim sheochlot veshotot ad shechashecha vehen enan yodot shemmitzva lehosif mechol al hakkodesh en memachin beyadan shello yavou laasot bezadon. shehare i efshar sheyyihye shoter bevet kol echad veechad lehazehir nashav. vehanach lahen sheyyehu shoggin veal yehu mezidin. vechen kol haddome laze:

Haochel beyom hakkippurim maachalin haruyin leechol laadam kechotevet haggassa shehi pachot mikkevetza kimat hare ze chayyav. vechol hoochalim mitztarfin leshiur ze. vechen hashshote mashkin haruyin lishtiyyat adam kimlo lugmav shel shote kol echad veechad lefi lugmav chayyav. vechamma melo lugmav kede sheyyesallekem letzad echad veyerae male lugmav. veshiur ze beadam benoni pachot merviit. vechol hammashkin mitztarfin leshiur ze. vehaachila ushetiyya en mitztarfin leshiur echad: 
Echad haochel ochalim hammuttarim o sheachal devarim haasurin kegon piggul venotar vetevel unevelot uterefot vechelev o dam hoil veachal ochalim haruyin laadam hare ze chayyav karet mishshum ochel beyom hakkippurim: 
Achal o shata pachot mishshiur ze eno chayyav karet. af al pi shehu asur min hattora bachatzi shiur en chayyavin karet ella al kashshiur. vehaochel o hashshote chatzi shiur makkin oto makkat mardut: 
Achal meat vechazar veachal im yesh mittechillat achila rishona ad sof achila acharona kede achilat shalosh betzim hare ellu mitztarfot lechashshiur veim lav en mitztarfot lechashshiur. shata meat vechazar veshata im yesh mittechillat shetiyya rishona ad sof shetiyya acharona kede shetiyyat reviit mitztarfin leshiur veim lav en mitztarfin: 
Achal ochalim sheenan reuyin lemaachal adam kegon asavim hammarim o serafim habbeushin o sheshshata mashkin sheenan reuyin lishtiyya kegon tzir o mureyas vechometz chay afillu achal veshata mehen harebe hare ze patur min hakkaret. aval makkin oto makkat mardut: 
Shata chometz mazug bemayim chayyav. hakkoses pilpelin vezangevil yavesh vechayyotze bahen patur. aval zangevil ratov chayyav. achal ale gefanim patur. luleve gefanim chayyav. veellu hen luleve gefanim kol shellivlevu beeretz yisrael merosh hashshana vead yom hakkippurim. yeter al ze hare hen keetzim ufatur. vechen kol kayyotze baellu: 
Achal tzali bemelach mitztaref hammelach labbasar. tzir sheal gabbe yarak mitztaref. mippene shemmachshire haochel hameoravim im haochel keochel hen chashuvim. haya savea meachila gassa sheachal ad shekkatz bimzono veachal yeter al savo patur kemi sheachal ochalin sheenam reuyin laachila. sheaf al pi shezze hammaachol hayyater rauy leraev eno rauy lechol mi shessavea keze: 
Chole sheyyesh bo sakkana sheshshaal leechol beyom hakkippurim af al pi sheharofim habbekiin omrin eno tzarich maachilin oto al pi atzmo ad sheyyomar dayyi. amar hachole eni tzarich veharofe omer tzarich maachilin oto al piv. vehu sheyyihye rofe baki. rofe echad omer tzarich veechad omer eno tzarich maachilin oto. miktzat harofin omrin tzarich umiktzatan omrin eno tzarich holchin achar harov o achar habbekiin. uvilvad shello yomar hachole tzarich ani. aval im amar tzarich ani maachilin oto. lo amar hachole shehu tzarich venechleku harofim vehayu kullam bekiin veellu sheamru eno tzarich keminyan sheamru tzarich maachilin oto: 
Ubbara shehericha lochashin lah beaznah sheyyom hakkippurim hu. im nitkarra datah bezikkaron ze mutav veim lav maachilin otah ad shettityashshev nafshah. vechen mi sheachazo bulmos maachilin oto ad sheyyeoru enav. vaafillu nevelot ushekatzim maachilin oto miyyad veen mashhin oto ad sheyyimtzeu devarim hammuttarin: 
Katan ben tesha shanim uven eser shanim mechannechin oto leshaot. ketzad. haya ragil leechol bishte shaot bayyom maachilin oto beshalosh. haya ragil beshalosh maachilin oto bearba. lefi koach habben mosifin leannot oto beshaot. ben achat esre shana ben zachar ben nekeva mitanne umashlim middivre sofrim kede lechannecho bemitzvot: 
Bat shetem esre shana veyom echad uven shelosh esre shana veyom echad sheheviu shete searot hare hen kigdolim lechol hammitzvot umashlimin min hattora. aval im lo heviu shete searot adayin ketannim hen veenam mashlimin ella middivre sofrim. katan shehu pachot mibben tesha en meannin oto beyom hakkippurim kede shello yavo lide sakkana:

Asur lirchotz beyom hakkippurim ben bechammin ben betzonen. ben kol gufo ben evar echad afillu etzba ketanna asur lehoshitah bammayim. vehammelech vehakkalla rochatzin et penehen. kalla kede shello titganne al balah. vehammelech kede sheyyerae beyafyo shenneemar <small>(yeshaya log 17)</small> "melech beyafyo techezena enecha". vead kamma nikret kalla ad sheloshim yom: 
Mi shehaya meluchlach betzoa o tit rochetz mekom hattinnofet kedarko veeno choshesh. umedicha ishsha yadah achat bemayim venotenet pat letinok. vehachole rochetz kedarko af al pi sheeno mesukkan. vechol chayyave tevilot tovlin kedarkan ben betisha beav ben beyom hakkippurim: 
Mi sheraa keri bazzeman hazze beyom hakkippurim. im lach hu mekanneach bemappa vedayyo. veim yavesh hu o shennitlachlech rochetz mekomot hameluchlachin bilvad umitpallel. veasur lo lirchotz kol gufo o litbol. sheen hattovel bazzeman hazze tahor mippene tumat met veen harchitza mikkeri litfilla bazzeman hazze ella minhag veen minhag levattel davar haasur ella leesor et hammuttar. velo amru sheharoe keri beyom hakkippurim tovel ella keshettikkenu tevila levaale kerayin uchevar bearnu shebbatla takkana zo: 
Tit shehu lach beyoter kede sheyyanniach adam yado alav vetaale bah lachluchit sheim hidbik otah leyado haacheret tidbak bah lachluchit asur leshev alav. lo yemalle adam keli cheres mayim veyitztannen bo shehammayim nizchalim middefanav. afillu kele mattachot asur shemma yinnatzu mayim al besaro. umuttar lehitztannen beferot: 
Lokeach adam mitpachat meerev yom hakkippurim veshore otah bemayim umenaggevah meat umannichah tachat habbegadim ulemachar maavirah al panav veeno choshesh veaf al pi sheyyesh bah kor harebe: 
Haholech lehakebil pene rabbo o pene aviv o mi shehu gadol mimmennu bechachma o likrot bevet hammidrash over bammayim ad tzavvaro veeno choshesh veose mitzva shehalach laasotah vechozer bammayim limkomo. sheim lo tattir lo lachazor eno holech venimtza nichshal min hammitzva. vechen haholech lishmor perotav over bammayim ad tzavvaro veeno choshesh uvilvad shello yotziu yedehem mittachat shule meilehem kederech sheosin bechol: 
Asur linol minal vesandal afillu beraglo achat. umuttar latzet besandal shel shaam veshel gemi vechayyotze bahen. vechorech adam beged al raglav veyotze bo shehare keshi haaretz maggia leraglav umargish shehu yachef. hattinokot af al pi shehen muttarin baachila uvishtiyya urechitza vesicha monin otan mimminal vesandal: 
Muttar lechol adam linol et hassandal mechamat akrav vechayyotze bah kede shello tishshachennu. vehachayya mutteret linol et hassandal mishshum tzinna kol sheloshim yom. vehachole kayyotze bah af al pi sheen sham sakkana: 
Asur lasuch miktzat gufo kechol gufo ben sicha shel taanug ben sicha sheenah shel taanug. veim haya chole af al pi sheen bo sakkana o sheyyesh lo chatatin berosho sach kedarko veeno choshesh: 
Yesh mekomot shennahagu lehadelik et hanner belele yom hakkippurim kede sheyyihye lo boshet panim meishto velo yavo lide tashmish hammitta. veyesh mekomot shennahagu shello lehadelik shemma yire ishto vetissa chen beenav veyavo lide tashmish. veim chal yom hakkippurim lihyot beshabbat chayyavin hakkol lehadelik bechol makom shehadelakat ner beshabbat chova: salik hilchot shevitat osor
Mishneh Torah, Ritual Slaughter 1:
Mitzvat ase sheyyishchot mi sheyyirtze leechol besar behema chayya veof veachar kach yochal shenneemar <small>(Devarim 12 21)</small> "vezavachta mibbekarcha umitztzoncha". veneemar bivchor baal mum <small>(Devarim 12 22)</small> "ach kaasher yeachel et hatztzevi veet haayyal". ha lamadta shechayya kivhema leinyan shechita. uveof hu omer <small>(Vayikra 17 13)</small> "asher yatzud tzed chayya o of" vegomer <small>(Vayikra 17 13)</small> "veshafach et damo" melammed sheshshefichat dam haof kishfichat dam hachayya: 
Vehilchot shechita bechullan achat hen. lefichach hashshochet behema o chayya o of mevarech techilla asher kiddeshanu bemitzvotav vetzivvanu al hashshechita. veim lo berech ben beshogeg ben bemezid habbasar muttar. veasur leechol min hashshechuta kol zeman shehi mefarkeset. vehaochel mimmenna kodem shettetze nafshah over belo taase. vahare hu bichlal <small>(Vayikra 19 26)</small> "lo tochlu al haddam" veeno loke. umuttar lachtoch mimmenna achar shechita kodem shettetze nafshah umolcho yafe yafe umedicho yafe yafe umannicho ad shettamut veachar kach yochlennu: 
Dagim vachagavim enan tzerichim shechita ella asifatan hi hammatteret otan. hare hu omer <small>(Bamidbar 11 22)</small> "hatzon uvakar yishshachet lahem umatza lahem im et kol dege hayyam yeasef lahem", asefat dagim kishchitat bakar vetzon. uvachagavim neemar <small>(yeshaya log 4)</small> "osef hechasil", baasifa levaddah. lefichach im metu mealehen betoch hammayim muttarin. umuttar leachlan chayyim: 
Zevicha zo haamura battora setam tzarich lefaresh otah veleda bee ze makom min habbehema shochatin. vechamma shiur hashshechita. uvee ze davar shochatin. umatay shochatin. vehechan shochatin. vechetzad shochatin. uma hen haddevarim hammafsidin et hashshechita. umi hu hashshochet. veal kol haddevarim haellu tzivvanu battora veamar <small>(Devarim 12 21)</small> "vezavachta mibbekarcha" vegomer <small>(Devarim 12 21)</small> "kaasher tzivviticha veachalta bisharecha" vegomer shekkol haddevarim haellu al pe tzivva bahen kishar tora shebbeal pe shehi hannikret <small>(Shemot 24 12)</small> "mitzva" kemo shebbearnu bitchillat chibbur ze:
