Mekom hashshechita min hachay hu hatztzavvar. vechol hatztzavvar kasher lishchita. ketzad. bavveshet mittechillat hammakom shekkeshechotchin oto mitkavvetz ad makom sheyyasir veyatchil lihyot peratzin peratzin kecheres. ze hu mekom hashshechita bavveshet: 
Shachat lemala mimmakom ze vehu hannikra tarbatz havveshet o lematta mimmakom ze vehu mittechillat bene meayim shechitato pesula. veshiur tarbatz havveshet sheeno rauy lishchita lemala bivhema vechayya kede sheyyochaz bishte etzbeotav uveof hakkol lefi gadlo vekatno. ulematta ad hazzefek: 
Vee ze hu mekom shechita bakkane. mishshippuy kova ulematta ad rosh kenaf harea keshettimshoch habbehema tzavvarah lirot. ze hu mekom hashshechita bakkane. vechol shekkeneged hammakom hazze mibbachutz nikra tzavvar: 
Ansa habbehema atzmah umashcha tzavvarah harebe o sheinnes hashshochet et hassimanin umeshachan lemala veshachat bimkom shechita batztzavvar venimtzet hashshechita bakkane o bavveshet shello bimkom shechita hare ze sefek nevela: 
Vetzarich hashshochet sheyyishchot beemtza hatztzavvar. veim shachat min hatztzedadin shechitato keshera. vechamma hu shiur hashshechita. shene hassimanin shehen hakkane vehavveshet hashshechita hameulla sheyyechatchu shenehen ben bivhema ben beof. velaze yitkavven hashshochet. veim shachat rov echad mehen beof verov hashshenayim bivhema uvechayya shechitato keshera: 
Shachat haechad kullo vechetzyah hashsheni bivhema shechitato pesula. rubbo shel ze verubbo shel ze af al pi shello shachat mikkol echad mehen ella yeter al chetzyo kechut hassaara hare zo keshera. kevan sheshshachat yeter al chetzyo kol shehu rubbo hu:

Hare sherainu yisreeli merachok sheshshachat vehalach lo velo yadanu im yodea im eno yodea hare zo mutteret. vechen haomer lishlucho tze ushechot li umatza habbehema shechuta veen yadua im shelucho shechatah o acher hare zo mutteret. sherov hammetzuyin etzel shechita mumchin hen: 
Avad lo gedi o tarnegol umetzao shachut babbayit muttar. sherov hammetzuyin etzel shechita mumchim hen. metzao bashshuk asur shemma nitnabbel ulefichach hushlach. vechen im metzao baashpa shebbabbayit asur: 
Mumche shennishtattek vahare hu mevin veshomea vedato nechona hare ze shochet lechattechilla. vechen mi sheeno shomea hare ze shochet: 
Hassuma lo yishchot lechattechilla ella im ken acherim roim oto veim shachat shechitato keshera: 
Akkum sheshshachat af al pi sheshshachat bifne yisrael besakkin yafa vaafillu haya katan shechitato nevela veloke al achilatah min hattora. shenneemar <small>(Shemot 34 15)</small> "vekara lecha veachalta mizzivcho". meachar shehizhir shemma yochal mizzivcho atta lamed shezzivcho asur veeno dome leyisrael sheeno yodea hilchot shechita: 
Vegader gadol gadru baddavar sheafillu akkum sheeno oved avoda zara shechitato nevela: 
Hitchil haakkum lishchot miut simanin vegamar yisrael o hitchil yisrael vegamar haakkum pesula. yeshnah lishchitato mittechilla vead sof. aval im shachat haakkum davar sheeno ose oto nevela kegon sheshshachat chatzi haggargeret bilvad vegamar yisrael hare zo keshera: 
Yisrael mumar laavera min haaverot shehaya mumche hare ze shochet lechattechilla. vetzarich yisrael kasher livdok et hassakkin veachar kach yittenenna lemumar ze lishchot bah mippene shechezkato sheeno toreach livdok. veim haya mumar laavoda zara o mechallel shabbat befarhesya o eppikoros vehu hakkofer battora uvemoshe rabbenu kemo shebbearnu behilchot teshuva hare hu keakkum ushechitato nevela: 
Mi shehu pasul leedut baavera min haaverot shel tora hare ze shochet beno leven atzmo im haya mumche. sheeno meniach davar muttar veochel devar issur. shezzo chazaka hi al kol yisrael vaafillu harshaim mehen: 
Ellu hatztzedokin vehabbaytosin vetalmidehen vechol hattoim acharehen sheenan maaminim battora shebbeal pe shechitatan asura. veim shachatu befanenu hare zo mutteret. sheen issur shechitatan ella shemma yekalkelu vehem enan maaminin betorat hashshechita lefichach enan neemanin lomar lo kilkalnu: 
Keshehayu yisrael bammidbar lo nitztauu bishchitat hachullin ella hayu nocharin o shochatin veochlin kishar haummot. venitztauu bammidbar shekkol harotze lishchot lo yishchot ella shelamim shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 17 3)</small> "ish ish mibbet yisrael asher yishchat shor" vegomer <small>(Vayikra 17 4)</small> "veel petach ohel moed" vegomer <small>(Vayikra 17 5)</small> "lemaan asher yaviu" vegomer <small>(Vayikra 17 5)</small> "vezavchu zivche shelamim laAdonai" vegomer. aval harotze linchor veleechol bammidbar haya nocher: 
Umitzva zo enah noheget ledorot ella bammidbar bilvad beet hetter hannechira. venitztauu sham shekkesheyyikkansu laaretz teaser hannechira velo yochlu chullin ella bishchita. veyishchatu bechol makom leolam chutz laazara shenneemar <small>(Devarim 12 20)</small> "ki yarchiv Adonai elohecha et gevulecha" vegomer <small>(Devarim 12 21)</small> "vezavachta mibbekarcha umitztzoncha asher natan Adonai elohecha" vegomer. vezo hi hammitzva hannoheget ledorot lishchot veachar kach yeachel:
Mishneh Torah, Ritual Slaughter 5:
Kevar bearnu behilchot issure maachalot shehatterefa haamura battora hi hannota lamut. velo neemar <small>(Shemot 22 30)</small> "terefa" ella sheddibber hakkatuv bahove kegon shetterafah ari vechayyotze bo ushevarah vaadayin lo meta: 
Veyesh sham cholaim acherim im yeeru lah techashev terefa vehen halacha lemoshe missinay. ushemona mine terefot neemru lo lemoshe besinay veellu hen. derusa. nekuva. chasera. netula. pesuka. kerua. nefula. ushevura: 
Af al pi shekkullan halacha lemoshe missinay hen. hoil veen lecha beferush battora ella derusa hechmiru bah. vechol safek sheyyistappek bidrusa asur. ushear shiva mine terefot yesh bahen sefekin muttarim kemo sheyyitbaer: 
Hadderusa hu sheyyitrof haari vechayyotze bo habbehema veyidros aleha beyado. o yidros hannetz vehannesher vechayyotze bahen al haof. veen derisa bivhema gassa uvechayya gassa ella laari bilvad. uvivhema dakka min hazzeev ulemala. uvigdayim utelaim afillu chatul veshual unemiyya vechayyotze bahen yesh lahen derisa vechol shekken beofot: 
Vehannetz yesh lo derisa vaafillu beof gadol mimmennu. aval shear ofot haddorsim yesh lahen derisa beof shekkemotan. veen lahen derisa beof shehu gadol mehen: 
Veyesh lechulda derisa beofot. vechelev en lo derisa kol ikkar lo beof velo bivhema vechayya. vehannetz yesh lo derisa bigdayim utelaim vehu sheyyikkov betzipparnav levet hechalal: 
En derisa ella beyad hattoref aval beraglav en choshshin lah. veen derisa ella betzipporen aval beshen en choshshin lah ella im ken nikkav ad bet hechalal bodkin shemma nikkav echad min haevarim shennitrefet binkivatan. veen derisa ella bechavvanat hattoref. aval im nafal haddores venishtakkeu tzipparnav bannitraf en zo derisa. veen derisa ella mechayyim. aval im daras veneherag vaadayin yado badderusa velo shamat tzipparnav mimmenna ella achar moto en choshshin lah: 
Vechetzad din hadderusa. kol makom sheamarnu choshshin lah shochatin et hannitraf uvodkin kol hechalal shello mikkaf hayyarech ad hakkadkod. im nimtzet kullah shelema mikkol mine terefot velo nimtza bah roshem hadderisa hare zo mutteret. veim nimtza bah roshem hadderisa hare zo terefa vaasura min hattora: 
E ze hu roshem hadderisa. sheyyadim habbasar keneged bene meayim. veim nimmok habbasar keneged bene meayim ad shennaasa kevasar sheharofe gorro min hachabbura roin oto habbasar keillu chaser uterefa: 
Veim daras bassimanin mishsheyyaadimu terefa uderisatan bemashshehu kevan sheheedim bahen kol shehu mechamat derisa terefa: 
Sefek derusa asura ad shettibbadek kidrusa vaddait. ketzad. ari shennichnas leven shevarim venimtza tzipporen begabbo shel echad mehen choshshin shemma ari deraso. veen omrim shemma bakkotel nitchakkech. vechen shual o nemiyya shennichnas leven haofot vehu shotek vehen mekarkerin choshshin shemma daras. aval im haya hu nohem vehem mekarkerin miyyirato uminnehimato hen mekarkerin. vechen im kata rosh echad mehen hinne nach ragzo. vechen im shatak hu vehem en choshshin sheillu hizzik hayu mekarkerin: 
Safek shennichnas lechan toref o lo nichnas. o sherainu velo noda im ze min hattorfin o eno min hattorfin en choshshin. vechen of shennichnas leven haetzim o leven hakkanim veyatza verosho menattef dam o tzavvaro en choshshin lo shemma nitraf ella omrim shemma baetzim nizzak:
Mishneh Torah, Ritual Slaughter 6: Nekuva ketzad. achad asar evarim hen sheim nikkav echad mehen lachalalo bemashshehu terefa. veellu hen. tarbatz havveshet. ukerum shel moach harosh. vehallev im hakkane shello. vehammara. ukene hakkaved. vehakkeva. vehakkeres. vehemses. uvet hakkosot. vehaddakkin. veharea im hakkane shellah:
Tarbatz havveshet kevar bearnu shiuro veshehu hammakom min havveshet sheeno rauy lishchita lemala min havveshet. im nikkav lachalalo bema shehu terefa:

Shene kerumot yesh lammoach shebbarosh. im nikkav haelyon hassamuch laetzem bilvad hare zo mutteret. veim nikkav hattachton hassamuch lammoach terefa. umishsheyyatchil hammoach lehimmashech lashshidra vehu michutz lappolin shehen techillat haoref yihye likrumo din acher. veim nikkav chutz lappolin muttar:
Hammoach atzmo shennikkav o nitmaech vehakkerum kayyam keshera. veim nishpach kammayim o names kaddonag terefa:

Hallev shennikkav levet chalalo. ben lechalal gadol shebbismol ben lechalal katan shebbeyamin terefa. aval im nikkav besar hallev velo higgia lachalalo muttar. ukene hallev vehu hammizrak haggadol sheyyotze mimmennu larea hare hu kallev veim nikkav lachalalo bemashshehu terefa:
Mara shennikkeva vechaved sotmah mutteret. veim lo nistam hannekev af al pi shehu samuch lakkaved terefa:

Neziyya shennimtzet bammara im hayta kemo garinah shel temara sheen roshah chad mutteret. veim roshah chad kegarinat hazzayit asura. shehare nikkeva otah keshennichnesa. veze shello yerae hannekev mippene shehuglad pi hammakka:

Kene hakkaved vehen hammizrekin shebbo shebbahen haddam mitbashshel. im nikkav echad mehen bemashshehu terefa. lefichach machat shennimtzet bechittuch hakkaved im hayta machat gedola vehaya hakkatze hachad shellah lefanim beyadua shennikkeva keshennichnesa. veim haya harosh heagol lefanim omrin derech simponot halcha umutteret:

Hayta machat ketanna hare zo terefa mippene sheshshene rasheha chaddin vadday nikkeva. veim nimtzet bassimpon haggadol shebbakkaved vehu hakkane harachav shebbaemtza shebbo nichnas hammaachol lakkaved hare zo mutteret. uvesar kaved shehitlia mutteret:

Keva shennikkeva vechelev tahor sotem et hannekev mutteret. vechen kol nekev shehabbasar o hachelev hammuttar baachila sotem oto hare ze muttar. chutz mechelev hallev vehakkerum sheal hallev kullo. vehammechitztza shebbeemtza habbeten hammavdelet ben evre hammaachol veevre hanneshima. vehi shekkorin otah veachar kach terae harea. vehi hannikret tarpash hakkaved. vehammakom hallavan shebbeemtzaah. vechelev hammei haacharon shebbeevarim ellu. en meginnin lefi shehen kashin. venekev shennistam beechad mehen eno kesatum. vechelev chayya shekkenegdo bivhema asur eno sotem af al pi shehu muttar baachila:

Keres shennikkav terefa. veen lo davar sheyyistom oto. shehare hachelev shealav asur. vechen hemses uvet hakkosot shennikkav echad mehen lachutz terefa. veim nikkav echad mehen letoch chalal chavero mutteret:

Machat shennimtzet boovi bet hakkosot mitztzad echad keshera. veim nikkeva nekev mefullash letoch chalal bet hakkosot venimtzet tippat dam bimkom hannekev terefa shevvadday kodem shechita nikkav. aval im en dam bimkom hannekev hare ze muttar shevvadday achar shechita dachaka hammachat venikkeva:

Behema shehilitah davar shennokev bene meeha kegon koret shel chiltit vechayyotze bo terefa shevvadday nokev. veim haya safek nokev safek eno nokev tibbadek. kol echad min bene hammeayim sheppesolet hammaachol sovevet bahen vehen hannikraim dakkin shennikkav terefa. veyesh mehen meluppafin umukkafin zo lefanim mizzo beiggul kemo nachash shennichrach veellu hen hannikraim hadera dechanta. im nikkev echad mehen lachavero keshera. shehare chavero megen alav:

Umeayim shennikkevu velecha sotamtan terefa sheen zo setima omedet. bene meayim shebba zeev o kelev vechayyotze bahen unetalan vahare hen nekuvin achar shehinnichan tolin bo umutteret veen omrin shemma bimkom nekev nikkav. nimtzeu nekuvin velo noda im kodem shechita nikkevu im achar shechita nokvin bahen nekev acher umedammin lo. im haya hannekev harishon kemoto keshera. veim haya benehen shinnuy kodem shechita nikkav uterefa. veim mishmeshu hayyadayim benekev hassafek kach tzarich lemashmesh bannekev shemmedammin lo veachar kach orchin ze laze:
Bene meayim sheyyatzu lachutz velo nikkevu mutteret. veim nithappechu af al pi shello nikkevu terefa. shei efshar sheyyachzeru kemot shehayu achar shennehefchu veenah chayya:

Hammei haacharon shehu shave veen bo ikkum vehu shehari yotze bo min haerva vehu davuk ben ikkere hayerechayim hu hannikra chalcholet. im nikkav bemashshehu terefa kishar hammeayim. bamme devarim amurim shennikkav lachalal habbeten. aval im nikkav bammakom haddavuk bayrechayim mutteret. vaafillu natal mimmennu mekom haddevek kullo mutteret. vehu sheyyishtayyer mearko bashshor kemo arba etzbaot:

Haof en lo keres velo hemses velo bet hakkosot. aval yesh lo kenegdan zefek vekurkevan. vechol hatterefot shavot hen bivhema chayya vaof. vezefek shennikkav gaggo bemashshehu terefa. vee zehu gaggo shel zefek ze sheyyimmatach im havveshet kesheyyaarich haof tzavvaro. aval shear hazzefek shennikkav muttar:
Shene kisin yesh bakkurkevan. hachitzon adom kemo basar. vehappenimi lavan kemo or. nikkav ze belo ze mutteret ad sheyyinnakvu shenehen bemashshehu. veim nikkevu shenehen ze shello keneged ze muttar:

Hattechol eno min haevarin shennekivatan bemashshehu ulefichach lo manu oto chachamim bichlalan ella yesh lannekev shello shiur sheeno shave bechullo. ketzad. hattechol rosho haechad ave vehashsheni dak kivriyyat hallashon. im nikkav barosh heave nekev mefullash terefa. veim nikkav nekev sheeno mefullash im nishar tachtav koovi dinar shel zahav muttar. pachot mikkan hare hu kimfullash uterefa. aval im nikkav haddak keshera:

Kol evar sheamru chachamim bo sheim nikkav bemashshehu terefa kach im nittal kullo terefa. ben shennittal becholi o bayyad ben shennivra chaser. vechen im nivra bishne evarim meoto evar terefa shekkol hayyater kenatul hu chashuv. ketzad. nittal echad min hammeayim o hammara vechayyotze bahen ben beof ben bivhema terefa. vechen im nimtza bahen shete merarot o shene meayim terefa. vechen kol kayyotze bahen. aval im nittal hattechol o shennimtzeu shenayim mutteret sheeno bichlal hammenuyin:

Hammei hayyater shettittaref bo habbehema hu hayyater mittechillato vead sofo ad shennimtzeu shene meayim ze betzad ze mittechilla vead sof kime haof o shehaya hammei yotze keanaf min habbad vahare hu muvdal ben beof ben bivhema. aval im chazar venitarev im hammei venaasa echad mishshene rashav vahare shenehem muvdalin baemtza hare zo mutteret veen kan yater:
Mishneh Torah, Ritual Slaughter 7:
Shenne kerumot yesh al harea. im nikkav ze belo ze mutteret. veim nikkevu shenehen terefa. afillu niglad hakkerum haelyon kullo vehalach lo mutteret. vehakkane shennikkav min hechaze ulematta bemashshehu terefa. vehu hammakom sheeno rauy lishchita bakkane lematta: 
Hitchil bishchita veshachat kol hakkane veachar kach nikkeva harea veachar kach gamar hashshechita hare zo terefa hoil venikkeva kodem gemar shechita. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Echad missimpone rea shennikkav afillu nikkav lachavero terefa. verea shennikkeva veala kerum bammakka venistam hannekev eno kelum. nikba haom shel rea af al pi sheddofen sotamtah terefa. veim nikkeva bimkom chittuch haunnot shellah vehu hammakom sherovetzet alav keshera: 
Bamme devarim amurim keshessatam mekom hannekev shebbaunnot basar. aval im nismach hannekev laetzem eno megen. veim haya nekev haunnot davuk baetzem uvabbasar mutteret: 
Haom shel rea shennimtzet semucha laddofen. ben sheheelat tzemachim ben shello heelat choshshin lah shemma nikkeva. vechetzad osin bah. mefarkin otah min haddofen venizharin bah shello tinnakev. im nimtzet nekuva venimtza baddofen makka bimkom hannekev tolin bammakka veomrim achar shechita nikkeva keshennifrak min hammakka. veim en makka baddofen beyadua shennekev ze barea haya kodem hashshechita uterefa: 
Harea shennimtza bah makom atum kol shehu sheen haruach nichneset bo veeno nitpach hare zo kinkuva uterefa. vechetzad bodkin oto. korin hammakom shello nitpach bishat neficha. im nimtzet bo lecha mutteret shemmechamat hallecha lo nichnesa sham haruach. veim lo nimtzet bo lecha notnin alav meat rok o teven o kanaf vechayyotze bahen venofchin otah im nitnadned keshera veim lav terefa sheen haruach nichneset lesham: 
Rea shettishshama bah havara keshennofchin otah im nikkar hammakom shemmimmennu tishshama hahavara moshivin alav rok o teven vechayyotze bo. im nitnadned beyadua shehi nekuva uterefa. veim lo nikkar hammakom moshivin otah bemayim poshrin venofchin otah. im bikbek hammayim terefa. veim lav beyadua shekkerum hattachton bilvad nikkav veharuach tenaheg ben shene hakkerumot umippene ze yishshama bah kol demama bishat neficha: 
Ze ikkar gadol yihye beyadcha shekkol rea shennofchin otah befoshrin velo yevakbek hammayim hare hi shelema mikkol nekev: 
Rea shennishpecha kekiton ukerum haelyon shellah kayyam shalem belo nekev. im hassimponot omdim bimkomam velo nimmochu keshera. veim nimmoach afillu simpon echad terefa. ketzad osin. nokvin otah veshofchin otah bichli shehu shoa baavar vechayyotze bo. im nire bah chutin levanin beyadua shennimmokku hassimponot uterefa. veim lav besar harea bilvad hu shennimmok ucheshera: 
Rea shennimtzeu bah avabuot im hayu meleim ruach o mayim zakkim o lecha hannimshechet kidvash vechayyotze bo o lecha yevesha vekasha afillu keeven hare zo mutteret. veim nimtzet bahen lecha serucha o mayim seruchin o achurin hare zo terefa. ucheshemmotzi hallecha uvodek otah tzarich livdok hassimpon shettachteha. im nimtza nakuv terefa: 
Rea shennimtzeu bah shete avabuot semuchot zo lazo terefa. shehaddavar karov harebe sheyyesh nekev benehen veen lahen derech bedika. hayta achat venire kishtayim nokvin haachat. im shafcha lah haacheret achat hi umutteret veim lav terefa: 
Harea shennitmasmesa terefa. ketzad. kegon shennimtzet shelema ucheshettolin otah techatech vetippol chatichot chatichot. rea shennimtzet nekuva bemakom sheyyad hattabbach memashmesh mutteret vetolin beyado veomrin miyyad hattabbach nikkeva achar hashshechita. nimtza hannekev bemakom acher veen yadua im kodem shechita o achar shechita nokvin bah nekev acher umedammin keshem sheosim bivne meayim: 
Veen medammin merea shel behema dakka lerea shel behema gassa ella middakka ledakka umiggassa legassa. nimtza hannekev beechad min haavabuot hare zo terefa veen omrin nikkov avabua acher venaaroch sheen haddavar nikkar: 
Machat shennimtzet barea nofchin otah. im lo yatza mimmenna ruach beyadua shezzot hammachat derech simponot nichnesa velo nikkeva. veim nitchattecha harea kodem neficha venimtzet bah hammachat hare zo asura shehaddavar karov shennikkeva keshennichnesa: 
Tolaat shehayta barea venikkeva veyatza vahare harea nekuva betolaat hare zo mutteret. chezkatah sheachar shechita tikkov vetetze. yesh sham marot sheim nishtanna mare haevar leoto hammare hara hare hu kenakuv sheoto habbasar shennishtannu marav lemare ze kemet hu chashuv ucheillu hu habbasar shennehefach eno eno matzuy. vechen hu omer <small>(Vayikra 13 10)</small> "umichyat basar chay baset" <small>(Vayikra 13 14)</small> "uveyom heraot bo basar chay" mikkelal sheshshear habbasar shennishtanna eno chay: 
Rea shennishtannu mareha. ben mare kulla ben mare miktzatah. im nishtannet lemare hammuttar afillu nishtannet kullah mutteret. veim nishtanna lemare haasur afillu kol shehu terefa. shehammare haasur kenekev hu chashuv kemo shebbearnu: 
Vechamesh marot asurot yesh barea veellu hen. shechora kidyo. o yerukka keen keshut. o keen chelmon betza. o keen charia. o kemare habbasar. vacharia hu hatztzeva shetztzovim bo habbegadim vehu dome lisarot adummot meat venotot lirukka: 
Nimtzet keen charayot shel dekel osrin otah missafek shezze karov lemare haasur. vechol hammarot haellu en osrin bahem ad shennofchim otah umemares bah beyado. im nishtannet lammare hammuttar mutteret. veim amda beenah asura: 
Arba marot muttarot yesh bah veellu hen. shechora kichchol. o yerukka kechatzir. o adumma. o kemare hakkaved. vaafillu hayta harea kullah telaim telaim nekuddot nekuddot mearba marot ellu hare zo mutteret: 
Of shennafal laur vehorik libbo o kevedo o kurkevano o shehedimu hammeayim shello bechol shehu hare zo terefa. shekkol hayerukkim shehedimu o haadummim shehoriku mechamat haur baof hare hen kemi shennittelu uterefa. vehu sheyyaamdu bemare ze achar sheshshalku otan meat umemarsin bahen: 
Kol of shennimtzet hakkaved shello kemare bene meayim. o shennishtannu shear bene meayim veamdu beshinnuyan achar shelika umerisa kemo shebbearnu. beyadua shennafal laur venechmeru bene meav uterefa. velo od ella bene meayim shel of shello nimtza bahem shinnuy ucheshennishleku nishtannu vehedimu hayerukkim vehoriku haadummim. beyadua shennafal laur venechmeru bene meav uterefa. vechen havveshet shennimtza haor hachitzon shello lavan vehappenimi adom ben baof ben babbehema hare hu keillu eno uterefa:
Mishneh Torah, Ritual Slaughter 8: Chasera ketzad. shene evarim hen sheim chaser mimminyanam terefa. veellu hen. harea veharaglayim. vechamesh unnot yesh larea kesheyyitle otah adam beyado ufene rea keneged panav. shalosh min hayyamin. ushetayim min hassemol. uvetzad yamin mimmenna kemo ozen ketanna veenah betzad haunnot veyesh lah kemo kis bifne atzmah vehi betoch hakkis. veozen zo ketanna hi hannikra varda mippene shehi doma levered veenah min hamminyan. lefichach im lo nimtzet havvarda mutteret. shekkach hi darkah yesh behemot timmatze bahem veyesh behemot lo timmatze bahem. veim nimtzet nekuva af al pi shehakkis shellah sotem et hannekev hare zo terefa:
Chaser minyan haunnot venimtzet achat min hassemol o shetayim min hayyamin terefa. veim nimtzeu shetayim beyamin vezot havvarda hare zo mutteret:
Nitchallefu haunnot venimtzeu shalosh min semol ushetayim min hayyamin belo vered. o shehaya havvered im hashshalosh betzad semol. hare zo terefa shehi chasera mitztzad hayyamin:

Nitvassefu haunnot beminyanam im hayta haozen hayetera betzad haunnot o millifne harea shehu leummat hallev mutteret. veim hayta al gabbah shehu leummat hatztzelaot hare zo terefa shehayyater kechaser. vehu shettihye kemo ale shel hadas. aval pachot mizze enah ozen umutteret:
Ozen shennimtzet devuka bachavertah hassemucha lah mutteret. veim nismechu shello al hasseder kegon shennismecha rishona lashshelishit terefa:

Nimtzeu shete haunnot keunna achat veenan nirot kishtayim devukot im haya benehen kemo ale hahadas ben beikkaran ben beemtzaan ben besofan kede sheyyukkar shehen shetayim devukot mutteret veim lav hare zo chasera uterefa:

Nimtzet kullah shete arugot veen lah chittuch aznayim terefa. vechen im chaser guf harea af al pi shello nikkeva hare zo kemi shechaser minyan haunnot uterefa. lefichach im nimtza mimmenna makom yavesh ad sheyyipparech betzipporen hare zo kechaser uterefa vaafillu haya kol shehu:
Rea shennimtzet nefucha kemo ikkar charayot shel dekel osrin otah missafek. shezzo tosefet meshunna begufah veshemma hattosefet bagguf kechissaron kemo sheamar beminyan:

Habbehema sheppachada veyara ad shetztzamka harea shellah vekarva lihyot yevesha. im pachada bide shamayim kegon sheshshama kol raam o raata zikkim vechayyotze baze mutteret. veim pachada bide adam kegon sheshshachatu lefaneha behema acheret vechayyotze baze hare zo kachasera uterefa:

Ketzad bodkin otah. moshivin et harea bemayim meet leet. veim haya zeman hakkor moshivin otah bemayim poshrin uvichli sheen hammayim mitmatztzin miggabbo venozlim kede shello yitztzonnu bimhera. veim haya zeman hachom moshivin otah bemayim tzonen bichli shehammayim mitmatztzin miggabbo kede sheyyishshaaru karim. im chazra livriyyatah hare zo bide shamayim umutteret. veim lo chazra bide adam hi uterefa:

Behema shehayta chasera regel bitchillat beriyyatah terefa. vechen im hayta yetera regel. shekkol hayyater kechaser hu. aval im hayu lah shalosh yadayim o yad achat mutteret. lefichach im nechtach hayyad shellah mutteret. nechtach haregel min haarkubba ulemala terefa. min haarkubba ulematta mutteret. bee zo arkubba amru bearkubba shehu sof hayyarech hassamuch lagguf:

Nishbar haetzem lemala min haarkubba im yatza kullo o rubbo lachutz hare ze kema shennechtach venafal uterefa. veim haya habbasar o haor chofe rov avyo verov hekkefo shel etzem shennishbar hare zo mutteret vaafillu nafal miktzat haetzem shennishbar vehalach lo. vegidim harakkim enan chashuvin kevasar:

Tzomet haggidin hen bivhema uvechayya lemala min heakev bemakom shettolin bo hattabbachim habbehema. vehen shelosha gidin levanim. echad ave ushenayim dakkim. umimmakom sheyyatchil vehen kashim ulevanim ad sheyyasur halloven mehen veyatchilu lehitaddem ulehitrakkech hu tzomet haggidim. vehu keorech shesh esre etzbaot beshor:
Uminyan gidim ellu baof shishsha asar gidin. techillatan min haetzem shel matta meetzba yetera ad sof haregel shehu asuy kaskassim kaskassim:

Behema shennechtechu ragleha bimkom tzomet haggidin terefa. veal titma vetomar ketzad tachtoch lemala mitztzomet haggidim vehi mutteret ad shettachtoch lemala min haarkubba haelyona kemo shebbearnu veim nechtach lematta mitztzomet haggidim asura. shebbitrefot tachtoch mikkan vetichye umikkan vetamut. velo neesra behema zo mippene shehi chatuchat regel mimmakom ze ella mippene shennechtechu haggidin shechatichatan mikkelal hatterefot kemo sheyyitbaer:
Netula ketzad. shelosha evarim hen sheim nittelu terefa veaf al pi sheen bahen din nekev velo din chesron. veellu hen. tzomet haggidim. vehakkaved. ulechi haelyon:

Uchevar bearnu shehabbehema shennechtach raglah vechen haof bimkom tzomet haggidim lo naasu terefa ella mippene shennechtechu haggidin. lefichach im nechtechu haggidim levaddam veharegel kayyemet terefa shehare nittela tzomet haggidim:

Nechtach bivhema haechad heave levaddo mutteret. shehare nisharu shenayim. nechtechu hashshenayim haddakkin mutteret shehare haechad heave gedol shenehen vahare lo nittal kol hatztzomet ella miutah. nechtach rubbo shel kol echad mehen terefa. veen tzarich lomar shennechtechu kullan o nittelu kullan:
Uvaof afillu nechtach rubbo shel (kol) echad min hashshishsha asar terefa:
Veof shennishtabberu agappav muttar kivhema shennechtechu yadeha:

Kaved shennittela kullah terefa. veim nishtayyer mimmenna kezayit bemakom shehi teluya bo uchezayit bimkom mara hare zo mutteret. niddaldela hakkaved vahare hi meora battarpash shellah mutteret. nittal mimmenna makom shehi teluya bo umekom hammara veaf al pi shehashshear kayyam kemo shehu terefa:
Nishar bah kezayit bimkom mara uchezayit bemakom shehi teluya bo keshera. aval haya mefuzzar meat bechan umeat bechan o shehaya meruddad o shehaya aroch kirtzua hare zo safek veyerae li shehi asura:
Lechi haelyon shennittal terefa. aval im nittal hattachton kegon shennigmam ad mekom hassimanin velo neekru hare zo mutteret:

Kol evar shenneemar bo sheim haya chaser terefa kach im nittal terefa. aval evar shenneemar bo im nittal terefa enah neeseret ella im nechtach oto evar. aval im nivret chasera oto evar hare zo mutteret. sheim lo tomar ken nimtzet hachasera vehannetula achat. vechol evar shenneemar bo sheim nittal mutteret kal vachomer im chaser mittechillat beriyyatah velo nivra shehi mutteret:
Behema shennittela haem shellah vehu bet harechem o shennittelu hakkelayot hare zo mutteret. lefichach im nivret bechuleya achat o beshalosh kelayot mutteret. vechen im nikkeva hakkuleya mutteret:

Af al pi shehakkuleya shennittela o chasera mutteret im nimtzet ketanna beyoter. vehakketanna bedaka ad kefol uvegassa ad keenav. terefa. vechen im lakta hakkuleya vehu sheyyease besarah kivsar hammet shehivish achar yamim sheim teechoz bemiktzato yitmasmes veyippol vehiggia choli ze ad hallavan shebbetoch hakkuleya hare zo terefa. vechen im nimtzet bakkuleya lecha af al pi sheenah serucha o shennimtza bah mayim achurin o seruchim hare zo terefa. aval im nimtzeu bah mayim zakkim hare zo mutteret:
Mishneh Torah, Ritual Slaughter 9:
Pesuka ketzad. chut hashshidra shennifsak haor hachofe et hammoach terefa. uvilvad sheyyippasek rov hekkefo. aval im nisdak haor learko o nikkav mutteret. vechen im nishbera hashshidra velo nifsak hachut shellah o shennitmaech hammoach shebbetoch hachut venitnadned hoil veoro kayyam hare zo mutteret: 
Humrach hammoach venishpach kammayim o kedonag shennames ad sheyyimmatze hachut keshemmaamido eno omed hare zo terefa. veim eno yachol laamod mippene kavdo hare zo safek: 
Ad hechan chut hashshidra. techillato mibbachutz lappolin shebbitchillat haoref ad sof parasha sheniyya shello yishshaer achareha ella parasha shelishit hassemucha litchillat haalya: 
Veshalosh parashiyyot hen veellu hen. shelosha atzamot devukin ze baze lematta mechulyot shel shidra. vechut hashshidra baof ad ben agappayim. aval lematta mimmekomot ellu en mashgichin al hachut hannimshach lesham ben shennifsak oro ben shennimrach hammoach: 
Kerua ketzad. basar hachofe et rov hakkeres vehu hammakom min habbeten sheim yikkara yetze hakkeres im nikra basar ze terefa. af al pi shello higgia hakkera lakkeres ad shenniret. ella kevan shennikra rov ovi habbasar hazze o nittal terefa. vechamma shiur hakkera bearko orech tefach. veim hayta behema ketanna venikra rov orech habbasar hachofe et hakkeres af al pi sheen beorech hakkera tefach terefa hoil venikra rubbah: 
Nikdar habbasar hazze beiggul o beorech im haya yater mikkesela vehu kede sheyyikkanes bo shalosh garine temara zo betzad zo bedochak hare zo terefa. sheim yimmatach kera ze yaamod al tefach: 
Behema shennifshat haor shealeha kullo ben shennikra bayyad o becholi venimtza basar belo or hare zo terefa. vezo hi shennikret geluda. veim nishar min haor rochav sela al pene kol hashshidra verochav sela al hattabbur verochav sela al rashe evareha hare zo mutteret. veim nittal kerochav sela meal kol pene hashshidra o meal hattabbur o meal rashe evareha ushear kol haor kayyam hare zo safek. veyerae li shemmattirin otah: 
Nefula ketzad. hare shennafla habbehema mimmakom gavoah sheggavho asara tefachim o yeter venitrassek evar meevareha hare zo terefa. vechetzad hu harissuk. sheyyitrotzetz haevar veyechele mechamat hannefila ad shettippased tzurato vetooro. af al pi shello nikkav velo nisdak velo nishbar hare zo terefa. vechen im hikka otah beeven o bematte veritztzetz evar meevareha terefa. bee ze evarim amru beevarim shebbachalal hagguf: 
Behema shennafla min haggag im halcha en choshshin lah. veim amda velo halcha choshshin lah. kaftza mechamat atzmah en choshshin lah. hinnichah lemala umetzaah lematta en choshshin lah shemma nafla: 
Zecharim hamenaggechin ze et ze en choshshin lahen. naflu laaretz choshshin lahen. vechen behema shehayta megareret ragleha en choshshin lah shemma nitrasseku evareha o shemma nifsak hachut shel shidra: 
Gannavim sheggonvin hattelaim umashlichin otan laachore haddir en choshshin lahen mishshum rissuk evarim. mippene sheen mashlichin otan ella bechavvana shello yishtabberu. veim hechezirum vehishlichum laddir mechamat yira choshshin lahen. mechamat teshuva en choshshin lahen. mippene shemmitkavven lehachaziram shelemim veyizzaharu behashelachatan: 
Shor shehirbitzuhu lishchita af al pi shennafal nefila gedola sheyyesh lah kol beet shemmappilin oto en choshshin lo mippene shennoetz tzipparnav umitchazzek ad shemmaggia laaretz: 
Hikka habbehema al roshah vehalcha lah hammakka kelappe zenavah o al zenavah vehalcha lah kelappe roshah vaafillu hikka otah bammatte al kol hashshidra en choshshin lah. veim yesh bammatte chulyot chulyot choshshin lah. veim higgia rosh hammatte lemiktzat hashshidra choshshin lah. vechen im hikka lerochav hashshidra choshshin lah: 
Of shennechbat al davar kashe kegon keri shel chittim o kuppa shel shekedim vechayyotze bahen choshshin lerissuk evarim. veim nechbat al davar rach kegon kesut kefula vehatteven vehaefer vechayyotze bahen en choshshin lo: 
Nidbeku kenafav bedevek bishat tzida venitchabbet. im bechanaf achat neechaz en choshshin lo. veim neechaz bishte kenafav venitchabbet begufo choshshin lo: 
Nechbat al pene hammayim im shat melo komato mimmatta lemala leemmat hammayim en choshshin lo. aval im shat mimmala lematta im hilluch hammayim choshshin lo shemma hammayim hem hammolichin oto. veim kadam leteven o kash shemmehallechin al gabbe hammayim hare zo shat mechamat atzmo veen choshshin lo: 
Kol makom sheamarnu en choshshin lah muttar lishchot miyyad. veeno tzarich livdok shemma nitrassek evar. vechol makom sheamarnu choshshin lah im shechatah tzarich livdok keneged kol hechalal kullo mikkadkod harosh ad hayyarech. im matza bah terefa min hatterefot shemmaninu o shennitrassek evar min haevarim shebbifnim venifseda tzurato hare zo terefa. afillu nitrassek evar min haevarim sheim nittelu keshera kegon techol uchelayot hare zo terefa chutz mibbet harechem sheim nitrassek hare zo mutteret: 
Vehassimanin enan tzerichin bedika bechan sheen hannefila memaechet otan: 
Nafla min haggag velo amda asur lishchot otah ad shettishhe meet leet. veim shachat betoch zeman ze hare zo terefa. uchesheshshochet otah achar meet leet tzericha bedika kemo shebbearnu: 
Vechen mi sheddaras beraglo al haof o shedderasattu behema o shetterafo lakkotel vahare hu mefarkes mashhin oto meet leet veachar kach shochatin oto uvodkin oto kederech shebbearnu: 
Simanim shenniddaldelu rubban terefa vaafillu shello mechamat nefila. vechen im nitkappelu shehare enan reuyin lishchita. aval im nitparek rov tarbatz havveshet min hallechi hare zo mutteret sheen hattarbatz rauy lishchita kemo shebbearnu:
Mishneh Torah, Ritual Slaughter 10: Shevura ketzad hu shennishtabberu rov tzaloteha. vetzalot habbehema hen achat esre mikkan veachat esre mikkan. nishtabberu shesh mikkan veshesh mikkan o achat esre mikkan veachat mikkan terefa. vehu shennishberu mechetzyan shel mul hashshidra:

Nishberu shesh mikkan veshesh mikkan im hayu tzelaot gedolot sheyyesh bahen moach terefa. veim lav af al pi shehen rov veaf al pi shennishberu kelappe hashshidra mutteret. vechen im neekru rov tzaloteha terefa. veim neekra afillu tzela achat vachatzi chulyatah immah shehatztzela tekua bah hare zo terefa. vechen im neekra min hashshidra chulya achat afillu hayta min hachulyot shellematta min hakkesalim sheen bahen tzelaot hare zo terefa:

Behema shennishmat hayyarech shellah meikkaro veyatza min hakkaf shello im nitakkelu nivav vehen hayetedot shebbeetzem hakkaf sheyyotzet al haetzem hazzachar veochezet oto hare zo terefa. veim lo nitakkelu mutteret:

Vechen baof im nishmat yerecho terefa. nishmat kenafo meikkaro choshshin shemma nikkeva harea shello ulefichach bodkin otah veachar kach yeachel. uvehema shennishmeta yadah meikkarah mutteret veen choshshin lah:
Gulgolet behema o chayya shennittal mimmenna kesela af al pi shello nikkav hakkerum terefa. veim nikkevu nekavim sheyyesh bahen chesron kullan mitztarfin lichsela:

Vechen gulgolet shennechbas rov gavhah verov hekkefah terefa. af al pi shehakkerum shalem velo chaser mimmenna kelum. nechbas rov gavhah vahare rov hekkefah kayyam o shennechbas rov hekkefah vahare rov gavhah kayyam hare zo sefek terefa. veyerae li sheosrin otah:

Of shel mayim kegon avazim im nikkav etzem gulgalto af al pi shello nikkav kerum shel moach terefa mippene shekkerumo rach. of hayyabbasha shehikkattu chulda al rosho o shenniggaf beeven o beetz manniach yado betzad hannekev venoetz o machnis yado letoch piv vedochek lemala. im yatza hammoach min hannekev beyadua shennikkav hakkerum uterefa. veim lav muttar:

Behema sheachazah dam o shehayta meushshenet o metzunnenet o sheachla sam shehoreg habbehema o shatta mayim haraim hare zo mutteret. achla sam shehoreg et haadam o shenneshachah nachash vechayyotze bo mutteret mishshum terefa vaasura mippene sakkanat nefashot:

Nimtzeu kol hatterefot hammenuyot kesheyyippartu veefshar sheyyimmatzu bivhema vechayya shivim. veellu hen al hasseder shennitbaaru bechibbur ze. 1) derusa. 2) nikkav tarbatz havveshet. 3) nikkav kerum shel moach. 4) nitmasmes hammoach atzmo. 5) nikkav hallev atzmo levet chalalo. 6) nikkav kene hallev. 7) nikkeva hammara. 8) nikkevu kene hakkaved. 9) nikkeva hakkeva. 10) nikkav hakkeres. 11) nikkav hemses. 12) nikkav bet hakkosot. 13) nikkevu meeha. yad) yatzu hammeayim lachutz venehefchu. 15) nikkav hattechol beavyo. 16) chasera hammara. 17) nimtzeu shete merarot. 18) chasera hakkeva. 19) nimtzeu shete kevot. 20) chaser hakkeres. ka) nimtzeu shene keresim. 22) chaser hemses. 23) nimtzeu shene mesasim. kad) chaser bet hakkosot. ko) nimtzeu shene batte hakkosot. 26) chaser echad min hammeayim. 27) nimtzeu shene meayim. koach) nikkeva harea. 29) nikkav hakkane lematta bemakom sheeno rauy lishchita. 30) nikkav simpon missimpone rea afillu lachavero. lo) neetam makom min harea. lev) nimmok simpon missimpone harea. log) nimtzea lecha serucha barea. lod) nimtzeu bah mayim seruchim. la) nimtzeu bah mayim achurin af al pi shello hisrichu. lo) nitmasmesa harea. 37) nishtannu mareha. lach) nehefach havveshet bemarav. lat) chasera harea mimminyan haunnot. 40) nitchallefu haunnot. ma) hotiru haunnot miggabbah. 42) nisrecha unna leunna shello kesidran. mag) nimtzea harea belo chittuch aznayim. 44) chaser miktzat harea. ma) yavesh miktzat gufah. 46) nimtzea harea nefucha veomedet. 47) tzamka harea mippachad adam. moach) chaser haregel ben mittechillat beriyyato ben shennechtach. mat) o shehayta yetera regel. 50) nittela tzomet haggidim. na) nittela hakkaved. nov) nittal lechi haelyon. 53) kuleya shehiktina beyoter. ned) kuleya shellakta. noah) kuleya shennimtzet bah lecha. 56) kuleya shennimtzeu bah mayim achurin af al pi sheenan seruchin. 57) kuleya shennimtzeu bah mayim seruchin. noach) nifsak chut hashshidra. 59) nimrach moach chut hashshidra venitmasmes. 60) nikra rov habbasar hachofe et hakkeres. 61) niglad haor shealeha. sav) nitrasseku evareha minnefila. 63) niddaldelu hassimanin. sad) nishtabberu rov tzaloteha. 65) neekru rov tzaloteha. 66) neekra tzela achat bechulyatah. 67) neekra chulya achat. sach) nishmat hayyarech meikkaro. 69) chasera haggulgolet kesela. 70) nechbas rov haggulgolet venitrotzetz:

Ellu hashshivim cholayim sheosrin et habbehema veet hachayya mishshum terefa kevar nitbaer kol echad mehen umishpatav. vechol sheefshar mehen sheyyimmatze baof baevarin hammetzuyin laof velabbehema dino bivhema uveof echad hu. chutz mitterefot shebbechuleya veshebbattechol veshebbeunnot harea. mippene shehaof en lo chittuch unnot kivhema. veim yimmatze en lo minyan yadua. utechol haof agol kemo enav veeno kitchol behema. uterefot shebbakkuleya veshebbattechol lo manu otan bivhema kede sheyyihye kenegdan baof ulefichach lo natnu lechuleya shehiktina shiur baof. vechen kol kayyotze baze:
Ushete terefot yesh baof yeter al habbehema veaf al pi sheyyesh lah otan haevarim. veellu hen. of shennishtannu mare bene meav mechamat haur. veof hammayim shennikkav etzem rosho:

Veen lehosif al terefot ellu kelal. shekkol sheera livhema o lechayya o leof chutz meellu shemmanu chachme dorot harishonim vehiskimu alehen bevatte dine yisrael efshar shettichye. vaafillu noda lanu midderech harfua sheen sofah lichyot:

Vechen ellu shemmanu veamru shehen terefa af al pi sheyyerae bedarche harfua shebbeyadenu shemmiktzatan enan memitin veefshar shettichye mehen en lecha ella ma shemmanu chachamim shenneemar <small>(Devarim 17 11)</small> "al pi hattora asher yorucha":

Kol tabbach shehu yodea hatterefot haellu vahare hu bechezkat kashrut muttar lo lishchot velivdok leatzmo velimkor veen baze chashash. sheed echad neeman beissurin ben yesh lo hanaya beeduto ben en lo hanaya beeduto. uchevar bearnu sheen lokchin basar mittabbach sheshshochet uvodek leatzmo bechutza laaretz o beeretz yisrael bazzeman hazze. ella im ken haya mumche. veim yatzat terefa mittachat yado menaddin oto umaavirin oto veeno chozer lechashruto ad sheyyelech lemakom sheen makkirim oto veyachazir aveda bedavar chashuv o yotzi terefa leatzmo bedavar chashuv:
Mishneh Torah, Ritual Slaughter 11:
Kol behema o of shennolod bahen sefek terefot mitterefot ellu. kegon behema shennafla velo halcha. o shennidresa bide chayya veen yadua im heedim basar keneged bene meayim o lo heedim. o shennechbesa gulgaltah veen yadua im rubbah o miutah vechayyotze bidvarim ellu. im haya zachar veshaha shenem asar chodesh hare zo bechezkat shelema kishar kol habbehemot. veim hayta nekeva ad shetteled. uveof bezachar shenem asar chodesh. uvinkeva ad shetteled kol habbetzim shel teina harishona vetiton teina sheniyya veteled: 
Veasur limkor sefek terefa zo lenachri betoch zeman ze shemma yimkerenna leyisrael: 
Kol behema chayya veof bechezkat beriim hem veen choshshin lahem shemma yesh bahen terefa. lefichach kesheyyishachatu shechita keshera enan tzerichin bedika shemma yesh bahen achat min hatterefot. ella hare hen bechezkat hetter ad sheyyivvaled lahen davar shechoshshin lo veachar kach bodkin al oto davar bilvad: 
Ketzad. kegon shennishmat haggaf shel of bodkin et harea shemma nikkeva. nafla habbehema bodkin otah shemma nitrasseku evareha. nitratztzetz etzem harosh bodkin kerum shel moach shemma nikkav. hikka otah kotz o nizrak bah chetz o romach vechayyotze bahen venichnas lachalalah choshshin lah utzericha bedika keneged kol hechalal shemma nikkav echad min haevarin shettittaref binkivatan. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Lefichach rea sheheelta tzemachin o shennimtzeu sirchot kemo chutin teluyin mimmenna veladdofen o lallev o letarpash hakkaved choshshin lah shemma nikkeva utzericha bedika. vechen im nimtza bah avabua male lecha choshshin shemma nikkav simpon shettachtav utzericha bedika: 
Min haddin haya al derech zo sheim nimtzet harea teluya besirchot kemo chutin. im hayu min haom shel rea veladdofen o shehayu lallev o letarpash hakkaved shechotchim et hassircha umotziin et harea venofchin otah befoshrin. im nimtzet nekuva terefa. veim lo nitbabea hammayim hare hi shelema mikkol nekev umutteret vesircha zo lo hayta bimkom nekev o shemma nikkav kerum haelyon bilvad. umeolam lo rainu mi shehora kach velo shamanu makom sheosin bo kach: 
Veaf al pi sheellu hen haddevarim hannirin middivre chachme haggemara. hamminhag happashut beyisrael kach hu. kesheshshochatin et habbehema o et hachayya korin et hattarpash shel kaved uvodkin et harea bimkomah. im lo nimtzea teluya besircha. o shennimtzea sircha ben ozen meazne harea velabbasar shebbimkom revitzatah ben basar shebben hatztzelaot ben basar shebbechaze. o shennimtzea sircha meozen leozen al hasseder o min haom laozen hassemucha lah. hare ellu mattirin otah: 
Veim nimtza chut yotze min haom shel rea leeze makom sheyyimmashech vaafillu haya kechut hassaara osrin otah: 
Vechen im haya min harea chut mashuch lallev o letarpash hakkaved o lechis hallev o lavvarda. ben shehaya hachut min haom shel rea ben shehaya min haozen vaafillu haya kechut hassaara osrin otah. vechen varda shennimtzet devuka bechisah o chut yotze mimmenna lechisah osrin otah. vechut hayyotze meozen leozen shello al hasseder osrin otah: 
Yesh mekomot shemminhagan im matzu sircha min haozen labbasar velaetzem shebbatztzelaot vehassircha devuka bishtehen osrin otah. veabba mari min haosrin vaani min hammattirin. umiut mekomot mattirin afillu nidbeka baetzem levaddo vaani oser: 
Veyesh mekomot shennofchin harea shemma yesh bah nekev. verov hammekomot en nofchin shehare lo nolad davar sheggorem lachashash. umeolam lo nafachnu rea bisfarad uvammaarav ella im nolad lanu davar shechoshshim lo: 
Udevarim haellu kullan enan al pi haddin ella al pi hamminhag kemo shebbearnu. umeolam lo shamanu bemi shebbadak of ella im nolad lo chashash: 
Mi sheshshachat et habbehema vekara et habbeten. vekodem sheyyivdok et harea ba kelev o akkum venatal et harea vehalach lo. hare zo mutteret. veen omrim shemma nekuva hayta o shemma devuka hayta. sheen machazikin issur. ella hare zo bechezkat hetter ad sheyyivvada bamme nitrefa. ucheshem sheen choshshin likrum moach velashshidra vechayyotze bahen kach lo nachush larea sheavda. veen baze minhag sheddavar sheeno matzuy en bo minhag: 
Ba haakkum o hayyisrael vehotzi harea kodem shettibbadek vahare hi kayyemet nofchin otah veaf al pi sheen anu yodin im hayu sham tzemachin o lo hayu. mippene pishshut hamminhag: 
Yesh mekomot sheim nimtzeu sirchot meduldalot min harea af al pi sheenan devukot lo laddofen velo lemakom acher osrin otah. vedavar ze hefsed gadol hu veibbud mamon leyisrael. umeolam lo nahagu ze lo betzarfat velo bisfarad velo nishma ze bammaarav. veen rauy linhog beminhag ze. ella nofchin otah bilvad. im nimtzet shelema min hannekev hare zo mutteret:
Mishneh Torah, Ritual Slaughter 12: Hashochet oto veet beno beyom echad habbasar muttar baachila vehashshochet loke shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 22 28)</small> "oto veet beno lo tishchatu beyom echad". veeno loke ella al shechitat haacharon. lefichach im shachat echad mishshenehen uva chavero veshachat et hashsheni chavero loke:

Issur oto veet beno noheg bechol zeman uvechol makom. bechullin uvemukdashin. ben kadashim hanneechalin ben kadashim sheenan neechalin. lefichach harishon sheshshachat baazara vehashsheni bachutz. o harishon bachutz vehashsheni baazara. ben shehayu shenehen chullin o shenehen kadashim. ben shehaya echad mehen chullin veechad kadashim. ze sheshshachat acharon loke mishshum oto veet beno:

En issur oto veet beno noheg ella bishchita bilvad shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 22 28)</small> "lo tishchatu" bishchitat shenehen hu haissur. aval im nachar harishon o nitnabbel beyado muttar lishchot. vechen im shachat harishon venichar hashsheni o nitnabbel beyado patur:
Cheresh shote vekatan sheshshachatu benam leven atzman et harishon muttar lishchot sheni acharehem. lefi sheen shechitatan shechita (kelal):
Hashshochet et harishon vahare hu sefek nevela asur lishchot hashsheni. veim shechato eno loke:

Shechita sheenah reuya laachila shemah shechita. lefichach harishon sheshshachat chullin baazara o terefa o shor hanniskal veegla arufa ufara adumma o sheshshachat leakkum uva haacharon veshachat et hashsheni loke. vechen im shachat harishon et haechad uva haacharon veshachat et hashsheni vahare hu chullin baazara o shor hanniskal o egla arufa ufara adumma hare ze loke:
Shechato leakkum patur mishshum oto veet beno shehare nitchayyev benafsho. veim hitru bo mishshum oto veet beno velo hitru bo mishshum akkum loke:

En issur oto veet beno noheg ella bivhema tehora bilvad shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 22 28)</small> "veshor o se oto veet beno lo tishchatu beyom echad". venoheg bechilayim. ketzad. tzevi shebba al haez veshachat haez veet benah loke. aval haez shebba al hatztzivya asur lishchot otah veet benah. veim shachat eno loke. para uvenah asra tora lo tzivya uvenah:

Hayta bat hatztzivya hazzot nekeva veyalda ben veshachat et hannekeva bat hatztzivya veet benah loke. vechen kilayim habba mimmin keves umimmin ez ben mikkeves im haez ben meez im hakkivsa loke mishshum oto veet beno:
Muttar lishchot et hameubberet. ubbar yerech immo hu. veim yatza haubbar chay achar shechita vehifris al gabbe karka en shochatin oto beyom echad. veim shachat eno loke:
Issur oto veet beno noheg binkevot shezze benah vadday. veim noda vadday shezze hu aviv en shochatin shenehen beyom echad. veim shachat eno loke. shehaddavar safek im noheg bizcharim o eno noheg:

Hashshochet et happara veachar kach shachat shene baneha loke shete malkiyyot. shachat et baneha veachar kach shachat hi loke achat. shechatah veet bittah veet ben bittah loke shetayim. shechatah veet ben bittah veachar kach shachat et habbat loke achat ben hu ben acher:
Shenayim shellakchu shete behemot ze haem veze habbat uvau ledin. ze shellakach rishon yishchot rishon vehashsheni yamtin lemachar. veim kadam hashsheni veshachat zacha veyamtin harishon ad lemachar:

Bearbaa perakim beshana hammocher behema lachavero tzarich lehodio velomar lo kevar macharti immah o bittah leacher lishchot kede sheyyamtin ze haacharon velo yishchot ad lemachar. veellu hen. erev yom tov haacharon shel chag. veerev yom tov harishon shel pesach. veerev atzeret. veerev rosh hashshana:

Bamme devarim amurim kesheraa ze shellakach baacharona nechpaz liknot vehaya besof hayyom shechezkato shehu shochet atta. aval im haya revach bayyom eno tzarich lehodio shemma lo yishchot ella lemachar:
Vehammocher et haem lechatan vehabbat lakkalla tzarich lehodian. shevvadday beyom echad shochatin. vechen kol kayyotze baze:

Yom echad haamur beoto veet beno hayyom holech achar hallayla. ketzad. hare sheshshachat rishon bitchillat lel revii lo yishchot hashsheni ad techillat lel chamishi. vechen im shachat harishon besof yom revii kodem ben hashshemashot shochet hashsheni bitchillat lel chamishi. shachat rishon ben hashshemashot shel lel chamishi lo yishchot hashsheni ad lel shishshi. veim shachat beyom chamishi eno loke:
Mishneh Torah, Ritual Slaughter 13:
Halokeach em al habbanim ushichatah. habbasar muttar baachila veloke al shechitat haem shenneemar <small>(Devarim 22 6)</small> "lo tikkach haem al habbanim". vechen im meta kodem sheyyeshallechenna loke. veim shillechah achar shellekachah patur: 
Vechen kol mitzvat lo taase shennitteka laase chayyav lekayyem ase shebbah. veim lo kiyyemo loke: 
Ba echad vechataf haem miyyado veshillechah o shebbarcha mittachat yado shello middato loke shenneemar <small>(Devarim 22 7)</small> "shalleach teshallach" ad sheyyeshalleach meatzmo vahare lo kiyyem ase shebbah: 
Natal em al habbanim vekitztzetz agappeha kede shello tauf veshillechah makkin oto makkat mardut. umashhe otah etzlo ad sheyyigdelu kenafeha umeshallechah. veim meta kodem laze o barcha veavda loke shehare lo kiyyem ase shebbah: 
Vechetzad meshalleach haem. ochez bichnafeha umafrichah. shillechah vechazra veshillechah vechazra afillu arba vechamesh peamim chayyav leshalleach shenneemar <small>(Devarim 22 7)</small> "shalleach teshallach": 
Haomer hareni notel et haem umeshalleach et habbanim chayyav leshalleach et haem shenneemar <small>(Devarim 22 7)</small> "shalleach teshallach et haem": 
Lakach et habbanim vehecheziran lakken veachar kach chazra haem alehen patur milleshalleach. shilleach et haem vechazar vetzad otah hare ze muttar. lo asra tora ella latzud otah vehi enah yechola lifroach bishvil habbanim shehi merachefet alehen shello yillakchu shenneemar <small>(Devarim 22 6)</small> "vehaem rovetzet al haefrochim". aval im hotziah mittachat yado vechazar vetzad otah muttar: 
Shilluach haem eno noheg ella beof tahor sheeno mezumman kegon yone shovach vaaliyya veofot shekkinnenu bappardes shenneemar <small>(Devarim 22 6)</small> "ki yikkare". aval hamezumman kegon avazin vetarnegolin veyonim shekkinnenu babbayit eno chayyav leshalleach: 
Hayu haefrochin mafrichin sheenan tzerichin leimman o betzim muzarot eno chayyav leshalleach. hayu efrochin terefot hare ellu kevetzim muzarot ufatur milleshalleach: 
Zachar shemmetzao rovetz al hakken patur milleshalleach. of tame rovetz al betze of tahor o of tahor rovetz al betze of tame patur milleshalleach: 
Hayta rovetzet al betzim sheenan minah vehen tehorin hare ze meshalleach. veim lo shilleach eno loke. hayta haem terefa chayyav leshallechah: 
Shachat miktzat simanin betoch hakken kodem sheyyikkachenna chayyav leshalleach veim lo shilleach eno loke: 
Hayta meofefet. im kenafeha nogot bakken chayyav leshalleach. veim lav patur milleshalleach. hayta matlit o kenafayim chotztzot ben kenafeha uven hakken hare ze meshalleach. veim lo shilleach eno loke: 
Hayu shene sidre betzim uchenafeha nogot basseder haelyon. o shehayta rovetzet al betzim muzarot vetachtehen betzim yafot. o shehayta em al gabbe em. o shehaya hazzachar al hakken vehaem al hazzachar. hare ze lo yikkach. veim lakach yeshalleach veim lo shilleach eno loke: 
Hayta yoshevet ben haefrochim o ben habbetzim veenah nogaat bahen patur milleshalleach. vechen im hayta betzad hakken uchenafeha nogot bakken mitztziddo patur milleshalleach: 
Hayta al shene badde ilan vehakken benehen roin kol sheillu yinnatlu habbaddin tippol al hakken chayyav leshalleach: 
Hayta rovetzet al efroach echad o al betza achat chayyav leshalleach. hammotze ken al pene hammayim o al gabbe baale chayyim chayyav leshalleach. lo neemar <small>(Devarim 22 6)</small> "efrochim o betzim" velo neemar <small>(Devarim 22 6)</small> "bechol etz o al haaretz" ella sheddibber hakkatuv behove: 
Asur lizkot babbetzim kol zeman shehaem rovetzet alehen. lefichach afillu hayta rovetzet al habbetzim o al haefrochim baaliyyato ushovacho enan mezummanin. velo kana lo chatzero. keshem sheeno yachol lizkot bahen laacherim kach lo tizke lo chatzero bahen. ulefichach chayyav leshalleach: 
Asur littol em al habbanim vaafillu letaher bahen et hametzora shehi mitzva. veim lakach chayyav leshalleach. veim lo shilleach loke. sheen ase doche lo taase vaase. (vaase) velo ase doche ase: 
Hammakdish of levedek habbayit ufarach miyyado vahare hu makkiro umetzao rovetz al haefrochim o al habbetzim lokeach hakkol umevian lide gizbar. sheen shilluach haem noheg bemukdashin shenneemar <small>(Devarim 22 7)</small> "veet habbanim tikkach lach" veellu enan shellecha: 
Of sheharag et hannefesh patur milleshalleach mippene shehu metzuvve lahavio levet din ladun oto:
Mishneh Torah, Ritual Slaughter 14: Mitzvat ase lechassot dam shichitat chayya tehora o of tahor shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 17 13)</small> "asher yatzud tzed chayya o of asher yeachel veshafach et damo vechissahu beafar". lefichach chayyav levarech kodem sheyyechasse baruch atta Adonai elokenu melech haolam asher kiddeshanu bemitzvotav vetzivvanu al kissuy haddam:

Kissuy haddam noheg bimzumman uvesheeno mezumman. lo neemar <small>(Vayikra 17 13)</small> "asher yatzud" ella bahove. venoheg bechullin velo bemukdashin. ben kadshe hammizbeach ben kadshe bedek habbayit. veim avar ushechatan eno chayyav lechassot et daman:
Shachat chayya veof veachar kach hikdishan o hikdish et haddam chayyav lechassot:

Kilayim habba mibbehema vechayya vechen beriyya shehi sefek behema o chayya tzarich lechassot veeno mevarech. hashshochet lechole beshabbat chayyav lechassot leachar shabbat. vechen hashshochet safek o kilayim beyom tov mechasse damo leachar yom tov:
Hashshochet ofot umine chayya bemakom echad mevarech beracha achat lechullan vechissuy echad lechullan:

Dam shennitarev bammayim im yesh bo mare dam chayyav lechassot veim lav patur. nitarev beyayin o bedam behema roin otan keillu hem mayim. im efshar sheyerae mare haddam shechayyav lechassoto keshiur ze illu haya mayim chayyav lechassot hakkol veim lav patur:
Kissahu venitgalla eno chayyav lechassoto paam acheret. kissathu haruach eno chayyav lechassot. chazar venitgalla achar shekkissathu haruach chayyav lechassot:
Dam hannittaz vesheal hassakkin im en sham dam ella hu chayyav lechassot:
Shachat venivla haddam bakkarka im rishshumo nikkar chayyav lechassot. veim lav hare ze kemi shekkissathu haruach ufatur millechassot:

En chayyav bechissuy ella dam shechita haruya laachila shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 17 13)</small> "asher yeachel". lefichach hashshochet venimtzet terefa. o hashshochet chullin baazara. o hashshochet chayya veof shennigmar dinan liskila vehashshochet venitnabbela beyado patur millechassot. vechen cheres shote vekatan sheshshachatu benan leven atzman peturin millechassot dam shechitatan:

Bamme mechassin besid uvegafsit bezevel dak uvechol dak sheen hayyotzer tzarich lechatsho uvishchikat avanim vacharasim uvinoret shel pishtan dakka uvinsoret charasim dakka uvilvena vecharsit umegufa shekketashah shekkol ellu min afar hen. aval im kafa alav keli o kissahu baavanim en ze kissuy shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 17 13)</small> "beafar":

Lefichach en mechassim bezevel gas vechol gas vekemach vesubbin umorsan ushechikat kele mattachot lefi sheen ellu min afar. chutz mishshechikat hazzahav bilvad shemmechassin bahem mippene shennikra afar shenneemar <small>(Iyov 28 6)</small> "veafrot zahav lo" veomer <small>(Devarim 9 21)</small> "ad asher dak leafar":

Mechassin beshichor vehu piach hakkivshan uvechochal uvenikrat pesilim uveefer ben efer etzim ben efer begadim afillu efer basar shennisraf shehare katuv <small>(Bamidbar 19 17)</small> "meafar serefat hachattat". umuttar lechassot beafar ir hanniddachat:
Hashshochet tzarich litten afar lematta veachar kach yishchot bo veachar kach yechasse beafar aval lo yishchot bichli vichasse beafar:
Umi sheshshachat hu yechasse shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 17 13)</small> "vechissahu beafar". veim lo kissahu veraahu acher chayyav lechassot shezzo mitzva bifne atzmah veenah teluya bashshochet levad:

Ucheshemmechasse lo yechasse beraglo ella beyado o besakkin o bichli kede shello yinhog bo minhag bizzayon veyihyu mitzvot bezuyot alav. sheen hakkavod leatzman shel mitzvot ella lemi shetztzivva bahen baruch hu vehitztzilanu millemashshesh bachoshech vearach otanu ner leyashsher hammaakashshim veor lehorot netivot hayysher. vechen hu omer <small>(Tehillim 119 105)</small> "ner leragli devarecha veor lintivati":
Mishneh Torah, Robbery and Lost Property: Kol haggozel et chavero sheve peruta over belo taase shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 19 13)</small> "lo tigzl". en lokin al lav ze shehare hakkatuv nitteko laase sheim gazal chayyav lehachezir shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 5 23)</small> "veheshiv et haggezela asher gazal" zo mitzvat ase. vaafillu saraf haggezela eno loke shehare hu chayyav leshallem dameha vechol lav shennittan letashlumin en lokin alav:
Veasur ligzol kol shehu din tora afillu akkum asur legazlo o leashko. veim gezalo o ashako yachzir:

E zehu gozel ze hallokeach mamon haadam bechazka kegon shechataf miyyado mittaltelin o shennichnas lirshuto shello birtzon habbealim venatal mishsham kelim. o shettakaf beavdo uvivhemto venishtammesh bahen. o sheyyarad letoch sadehu veachal peroteha vechol kayyotze baze hu gozel. kainyan shenneemar <small>(Shmuel 2 23 21)</small> "vayyigzl et hachanit miyyad hammitzri":

E zehu oshek ze shebba mamon chavero letoch yado birtzon habbealim vechevan shettevauhu kavash hammamon etzlo bechazka velo hecheziro. kegon shehaya lo beyad chavero halevaa o sechirut vehu tovo veeno yachol lehotzi mimmennu mippene shehu allam vekashe. veal ze neemar <small>(Vayikra 19 13)</small> "lo taashok et reacha":

Kol haggozel chayyav lehachezir haggezela atzmah shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 5 23)</small> "veheshiv et haggezela asher gazal". veim avda o nishtannet meshallem dameha. ben shehoda mippi atzmo ben shebbau alav edim sheggazal hare ze chayyav leshallem hakkeren bilvad. afillu gazal kora uvenaah babbira hoil velo nishtannet din tora hu sheyyaharos et kol habbinyan veyachzir kora livaleha. aval tikkenu chachamim mippene takkanat hashshavim sheyyihye noten et dameha velo yafsid habbinyan. vechen kol kayyotze baze. afillu gazal kora vaasaah besukkat hechag uva baal hakkora letavah betoch hechag noten lo et dameha. aval achar hechag hoil velo nishtannet velo benaah betit machzir et hakkora atzmah:

Haggozel pachot mishsheve peruta af al pi sheavar eno betorat hashavat gezela. gazal shalosh aguddot shavot shalosh perutot vehuzzelu vahare shelashtan shavot shete perutot vehechzir lo shetayim chayyav lehachezir hashshelishit hoil uvattechilla hayta shava peruta. gazal shetayim shevot peruta vehechzir achat gezela en kan mitzvat hashavat gezela en kan:

Haggozel et chavero bayyishshuv vehechzir lo gezelato bammidbar harshut beyad hannigzal im ratza notel veim lav omer lo eni notel ella bayyishshuv shemma teanes mimmenni kan. vahare hi birshut haggazlan uveacharayuto ad sheyyachazirennah lo bayyishshuv. vechen bidme haggezela:

Haggozel et chavero vehivlia lo becheshbon yatza. veim hechzir lechiso sheyyesh bo maot yatza sheadam asuy lemashmesh bechiso bechol shaa vahare mana hammaot shehechzir lo bichlal meotav uminyan shello middaat poter. veim hechzir lechis sheen bo kelum lo yatza vechayyav beacharayut haggezela ad sheyyodio shehechzir lechis peloni:

Kol hachomed avdo o amato o beto vechelav shel chavero o davar sheefshar lo sheyyiknehu mimmennu vehichbir alav bereim vehiftzir bo ad shellekacho mimmennu af al pi shennatan lo damim rabbim hare ze over belo taase shenneemar <small>(Shemot 20 14)</small> <small>(Devarim 5 18)</small> "lo tachmod". veen lokin al lav ze mippene sheen bo maase. veeno over belav ze ad sheyyikkach hachefetz shechamad. kainyan shenneemar <small>(Devarim 7 25)</small> "lo tachmod kesef vezahav alehem velakachta lach". chimmud sheyyesh bo maase:

Kol hammitavve beto o ishto vechelav shel chavero. vechen kol kayyotze bahen mishshear devarim sheefshar lo liknotan mimmennu. kevan shechashav belibbo heach yikne davar ze venifta belibbo baddavar avar belo taase shenneemar <small>(Devarim 5 18)</small> "lo titavve" veen taava ella ballev bilvad:

Hattaava mevia lide chimmud vehachimmud mevi lide gezel. sheim lo ratzu habbealim limkor af al pi shehirba lahem bedamim vehiftzir bereim yavo lide gezel shenneemar <small>(Micha 2 2)</small> "vechamdu battim vegazalu". veim amdu habbealim befanav lehatztzil mamonam o menauhu milligzol yavo lide shefichut damim. tze ulemad mimmaase achav venavot:

Ha lamadta shehammitavve over belav echad vehakkone davar shehitavva beheftzer shehiftzir babbealim o bevakkasha mehen over bishne lavin. lechach neemar <small>(Shemot 20 14)</small> <small>(Devarim 5 18)</small> "lo tachmod" v<small>(Devarim 5 18)</small> "lo titavve". veim gazal avar bishlosha lavin:

Kol haggozel et chavero sheve peruta keillu notel nishmato mimmennu shenneemar <small>(Mishlei 1 19)</small> "ken archot kol botzea batza et nefesh" vegomer. veaf al pi chen im lo hayta haggezela kayyemet veratza haggazlan laasot teshuva uva meelav vehechzir deme haggezela. takkanat chachamim hi sheen mekabbelin mimmennu ella ozrin oto umochalin lo kede lekarev hadderech hayeshara al hashshavim. vechol hamekabbel mimmennu deme haggezela en ruach chachamim nocha hemennu:

Haggezela shello nishtannet ella hare hi kemo shehayta af al pi shennityaashu habbealim mimmenna veaf al pi shemmet haggazlan vahare hi beyad banav hare zo chozeret livaleha beatzmah. veim nishtannet beyad haggazlan af al pi sheadayin lo nityaashu habbealim mimmenna kenaah beshinnuy umeshallem dameha kishat haggezela:

Vedin ze din tora hu shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 5 23)</small> "veheshiv et haggezela asher gazal". mippi hashshemua lamdu im hi kesheggezalah meshallem otah veim nishtannet beyado meshallem dameha. nityaashu habbealim mimmenna velo nishtannet kana haggazlan kol hashshevach shehishbicha achar yeush veeno meshallem ella kishat haggezela. vedavar ze middivrehem mippene takkanat hashshavim. ucheshemmachzir lo haggezela shamin lo hashshevach venotel min hannigzal:

Mecharah haggazlan o netanah bemattana af al pi shello nishtannet haggezela enah chozeret beatzmah miyyad hallokeach hoil venityaashu habbealim ben lifne mechira unetina ben leachar mechira unetina kenaah hallokeach beyeush veshinnuy reshut:

Haggozel vehishbiach umachar o horish lifne yeush ma shehishbiach horish uma shehishbiach machar vekana lokeach o yoresh et hashshevach. venotel deme hashshevach min hannigzal umachazir lo haggezela. vechozer hannigzal venotel deme hashshevach min haggazlan shehare lo nityaesh. vechen im hishbiach hallokeach o hayyoresh notel hashshevach min hannigzal:

Machar haggazlan leakkum af al pi shehishbiach haakkum chozeret livaleha. mecharah haakkum leyisrael achar shehishbiach hoil vehaggazlan yisrael veze shehi beyado yisrael kana hashshevach. veim tafas hannigzal en motziin miyyado:

Kevar bearnu shehaggezela shehishbicha achar yeush o achar shennishtannet hashshevach laggazlan mippene takkanat hashshavim af al pi shehishbicha meeleha. ketzad. gazal para venitabbera etzlo ben sheyyalda kodem shettevao bedin ben sheadayin lo yalda. gazal rachel venitana etzlo ben sheggezazah kodem shettevao baddin ben sheadayin lo gezazah. hoil venityaashu habbealim meshallem kishat haggezela. veim yalda ugezazah haggizzot vehavveladot shel gazlan. veim adayin lo yalda velo gezazah shamin lo venotel hashshevach min hannigzal umachazir habbehema atzmah:

Gazal para meubberet venityaashu habbealim veachar kach yalda. rachel teuna venityaashu habbealim veachar kach gezazah. meshallem deme para haomedet leled udeme rachel haomedet liggazez. veim lifne yeush o kodem shennishtanna yalda o gezazah hare haggizzot vehavveladot shel bealim. veaf al pi shennitabbera o nitana beyad haggazlan hoil velo nityaashu habbealim velo nishtannet haggezela. birshut bealeha hi adayin af al pi shehaggazlan chayyav boonaseha:

Ganav o gazal vehikdish vetavach achar shennityaashu habbealim hare hi birshut haggazlan mishshaa shehikdishah bilvad kede shello yehe chote niskar. vechol valdoteha vegizzoteha mishsheat geneva ad sheat hekdesh shel bealim:

Bamme devarim amurim beshevach habba meelav kegon gizzot uveladot. aval im hayta kechusha ufittemah afillu lifne yeush notel min hannigzal shevach happittum. vechen kol kayyotze baze mishshevach sheyyesh bo hotzaa:
Shinnuy hachozer livriyyato eno shinnuy. ketzad. haggozel etzim vedibbekan bemasmerim veasa mehen teva eno shinnuy shehare efshar lefarkan vechozrin luchot keshehayu:

Gazal afar vaasaahu levena lo kana sheim yadok hallevena tachzor afar keshehayta. gazal lashon shel mattechet vaasaahu matbea lo kana sheim yattich hammatbea yachzor lashon keshehayta. vechen kol kayyotze baze:

Aval haggozel etzim userafan vekitztzetzan o chakak bahen vaasaan kelim. o sheggazal tzemer utzevao o nippetzo velibbeno. o sheggazal tavuy veasahu beged. o sheggazal levena vaasaah afar o avanim vesittetan o maot vehittichan. hare ze shinnuy beyado sheim yaasem maot acherot panim chadashot hen. vechen kol kayyotze bahen:

Haggozel maot yeshanot veshafan vechiddeshan lo kana shehare mityashshenin vechozrin keshehayu. gazal maot chadashim veyishshenam kana sheim yechaddeshem panim chadashot hen. gazal dekel mechubbar vekitztzetzo lo kana vaafillu kerato chulyot chulyot. asahu korot kana:

Gazal korot gedolot vaasaan ketannot lo kana. asaan luchot ad shennishtanna shemam kana. gazal lulav vehifrid alav kana healim. gazal alim vaasaan chuppiyay kana. gazal tale venaasa ayil egel venaasa shor hare ze shinnuy beyado vekanahu umeshallem kishat haggezela. veaf al pi shello nityaashu habbealim:

Gazal keli ushevaro en shamin lo happechat ella meshallem damav vehakkeli hashshavur shel gazlan. veim ratzu habbealim littol hakkeli hashshavur notlin umeshallem happechat. shezzo takkana hi labbealim veim lo ratzu harshut beyadan. vechen kol kayyotze baze:

Gezela shello nishtannet vehukera af al pi shennityaashu habbealim mimmenna hare zo chozeret labbealim veen laggazlan bah kelum. shello tikkenu laggazlan et hashshevach achar yeush ella kegon gizzot uveladot. aval shevach hayyoker im hayta haggezela chozeret beeneha eno zoche bah:

Haggozel chavit shel yayin mechavero vahare hi shava dinar bishat haggezela vehukera etzlo veamda bearbaa. im shavar hechavit o shata otah o mecharah o netanah bemattana achar shehukera meshallem arbaa kishat hotzaa min haolam sheillu hinnichah hayta chozeret beatzmah. nishbera meeleha o avda meshallem dinar kishat haggezela: 
Hayta shava bishat haggezela arbaa uvishat hotzaa min haolam dinar. meshallem arbaa kishat haggezela. ben sheshshevarah o shetaah ben shennishbera o avda meeleha. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Haggozel chotel sheyyesh bo chamishshim temarim uchesheyyimkor hachotel kullo keachat yimkor betisha uchesheyyimkor achat achat yimkor baasara. eno meshallem ella tisha. veen hannigzal yachol lomar lo ani achat achat hayiti mocher. vechen haddin bemazzik. vechen kol kayyotze baze benichse hedyot. aval behekdesh eno ken ella meshallem asara: 
Gazal behema vehizkina o kachasha kachash sheeno yachol lachzor kegon cholaim sheen lahem refuat teala. o sheggazal matbea venisdak o pesalo hammelech. o sheggazal perot vehirkivu kullan. o sheggazal yayin vehechmitz. hare ze kemi sheggazal keli ushevaro umeshallem kishat haggezela. aval im gazal behemot vechachashu kachash sheefshar lachzor. o sheggazal avadim vehizkinu. o sheggazal matbea venifsal bimdina zo vahare hi yotze bimdina acheret. o sheggazal perot vehirkivu miktzatam. o teruma venitmet. o sheggazal chametz veavar alav happesach. o behema veneevda bah avera. o nifsela millikkarev. o shehayta yotza lehissakel. omer lo hare shellecha lefanecha umachazir otah beatzmah: 
Bamme devarim amurim keshehechezir haggezela. aval im nisrefa haggezela o avda achar shenneesra bahanaa chayyav lehachezir lo dameha kishat haggezela. lefichach im kafar bo achar shenneesra bahanaa venishba chayyav leshallem keren vechomesh veasham: 
Haggozel behema venasa aleha massa o rachav aleha o charash o dash bah vechayyotze baze vehechzir livaleha af al pi sheavar belo taase eno chayyav leshallem kelum shehare lo hifsidah velo hichchishah. veim huchzak adam ze ligzol o laashok o laasot maasim ellu paam achar paam konsin oto vaafillu bechutza laaretz. veshamin hassachar o hashshevach shehishbiach babbehema umeshallem lannigzal: 
Hattokef avdo shel chavero veasa bo melacha velo bittelo mimmelacha acheret patur shennoach lo laadam shello yibbatel avdo. veim bittelo mimmelacha acheret meshallem lo kefoel: 
Hattokef sefinato shel chavero veasa bah melacha im enah asuya lesachar shamin kamma pachata umeshallem. veim hi asuya lesachar im yarad lah betorat sechirut hoil veyarad shello birshut im ratza habbaal littol secharah notel ratza littol pechatah notel. veim yarad lah betorat gezel noten happechat. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Haddar bachatzar chavero shello middato. im otah chatzer enah asuya lesachar eno tzarich lehaalot lo sachar. af al pi shedderech ze haddar liskor makom leatzmo. shezze nehene veze eno chaser. veim hechatzer asuya lesachar af al pi sheen derech ze liskor tzarich lehaalot lo sachar shehare chissero mamon: 
Mi shehaya lo tzemer vesammanim sheruyin uva echad vetzava hatztzemer bassammanin shello middaat chavero. meshallem lo deme ma shehifsid batztzemer veeno mechashshev lo shevach sammanin sheal gabbe hatztzemer. veim tafas hannizzak deme ma shechasru min hassammanin en motziin miyyado: 
Hashsholeach yad befikkadon ben sheshshalach yad beatzmo o al yad beno veavdo ushelucho hare ze gazlan venitchayyev beonasav. venaaset haggezela birshuto kedin kol haggazlanim. chashav lishloach yad befikkadon eno chayyav beacharayuto ad sheyyishlach yad. umishsheshalach yad nitchayyev bo. af al pi shello chasar mimmennu kelum ella natal happikkadon mimmakom lemakom birshuto kede lishloach bo yad hare ze chayyav sheshshelichut yad enah tzericha chissaron: 
Higbiah et hechavit littol mimmenna reviit nitchayyev boonaseha af al pi shello natal. aval im higbiah et hakkis littol mimmennu dinar vechayyotze bakkis middevarim sheenan guf echad hare ze safek im nitchayyev bechol hakkis o lo nitchayyev ella bedinar bilvad: 
Hayu perot mufkadin etzlo venatal miktzatan eno chayyav ella beacharayut happerot shennatal ushear happikkadon hammunnach bimkomo birshut bealav hu. veim nifsad hashshear mechamat ze shennatal chayyav bakkol. ketzad. hitta et hechavit bimkomah venatal mimmenna reviit o yeter im nishbera achar shennatal vehi bimkomah eno chayyav ella kamma shennatal shehare lo higbiah hechavit. veim hechmitza meshallem et deme kullah kishat haggezela. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Hakkofer befikkadon bevet din. im haya birshuto bishat shekkafar naasa alav gazlan vechayyav beanso: 
Hashshoel shello middaat habbealim hare ze gazlan. haya keli beyad beno shel baal habbayit o beyad avdo ulekacho echad mehen venishtammesh bo hare ze shoel shello middaat venaasa birshuto venitchayyev boonasav ad sheyyachzirenu labbealim. lefichach im hecheziro lekatan shehaya beyado o leeved veavad mehen o nishbar chayyav leshallem. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Hachotef mashkon miyyad hallo shello birshut bet din hare ze gazlan af al pi shehu chayyav lo. veen tzarich lomar im nichnas letoch bet chavero umishkeno shehu gazlan shenneemar <small>(Devarim 24 11)</small> "bachutz taamod":

Kennas kansu chachamim laggazlanin sheyyihye hannigzal nishba al kol ma sheyyiton venotel min haggazlan. vehu sheyyihye ze muchzak sheggezalo bishne edim: 
Ketzad. hare shennichnas letoch bet chavero lemashkeno bifne edim velo haya kelum tachat kenafav veyatza vechelim muttalin lo tachat kenafav velo yadu haedim ma hen uvaal habbayit omer kach vechach gezaltani. ben sheamar haggazlan meolam lo nichnasti velo natalti kelum. ben sheamar nichnasti lemashken kemo sherau haedim aval lo natalti velo haya tachat kenafay ella kelim shelli. ben sheamar natalti keli ze uvaal habbayit toen shennatal ze ucheli acher. hare baal habbayit nishba binkitat chefetz venotel kol ma sheyyiton: 
Bamme devarim amurim beshettaan devarim shehu amud bahen o shehu amud shemmafkidin etzlo otan devarim shettaan vetaan bidvarim sheefshar sheyyinnatlu tachat hakkenafayim kemo sheheidu haedim: 
Rauhu edim shennichnas lemashken et chavero velo rauhu beet sheyyatza o sheyyatza veen nire tachat kenafav kelum uvaal habbayit toen veomer kach vechach natal. afillu omer meolam lo nichnasti shehare machchish et haedim hare ze patur. sheim amar nichnasti velo natalti nishba shevuat hesset shello natal kelum veholech. sheefshar sheyyikkanes ligzol velo gazal: 
Haya ed echad meido shennichnas venatal kelim tachat kenafav veeno yodea ma hen. vehu omer lo gazalti kelum o sheamar bechovi natalti. hoil veen haed yodea me haya tachat kenafav hare ze nishba binkitat chefetz shello gazal. sheeno muchzak begazlanut ella bishne edim: 
Keshem shebbaal habbayit nishba venotel min haggazlan kach shomer shel baal habbayit afillu ishto shel shomer nishbaat shezze natal kach vechach umeshallem haggazlan: 
Haya sham lekito o sechiro shel baal habbayit enan nishbain venotlin. veen hannigzal yachol lishshava shehare lo haya beveto beshaa shennigzal veen haedim yodim ma natal tachat kenafav kede lechayyev haggazlan lehachezir. veen mashbiin et haggazlan mippene shehu chashud al hashshevua: 
Vechetzad osim bedin ze. macharim baal habbayit cherem setam al mi shennatal mibbeto kelum veeno mode bevet din. vaafillu hoda haggazlan sheggazal ketzat machzir hammiktzat shehoda bah bilvad shehare en baal habbayit toano taanat vadday: 
Haggozel echad mechamishsha veen yadua mi hu hannigzal vechol echad veechad mehen tovo veomer li gazalta af al pi sheen sham edim sheggazal hare kol echad mehen nishba shezze gezalo umeshallem gezela lechol echad veechad. af davar ze kenas hu shekkenasuhu chachamim mippene sheavar avera vegazal. aval din tora eno chayyav leshallem missafek: 
Amar lishnayim gazalti echad mikkem o aviv shel echad mikkem veeni yodea ezehu. im ba latzet yede shamayim chayyav leshallem gezela lechol echad veechad. aval bedin eno noten ella gezela achat vehen cholkin otah benehen. shehare en echad mehen yodea shennigzal ella ze ba vehodiam. velo kansu chachamim bedavar ze mippene sheen lo tovea: 
Hattoen et chavero veamar lo gezaltani mea. im amar lo gazalti nishba shevuat hesset kedin kol nitba. veim hoda sheggezalo chamishshim meshallem chamishshim venishba shevuat hattora al hashshear kedin kol mode bemiktzat shehare lo huchzak gazlan beedim. vechen hattoen et chavero shennichnas leveto ugezalo kelim vehu omer derech mashkon lakachti bechov sheyyesh li etzlecha uvaal habbayit omer en lecha beyadi kelum af al pi shehoda shemmishkeno shello birshut hoil veen sham edim shemmeidim sheggazal hare ze nishba vegove chovo min hammashkon shehappe sheasar hu happe shehittir. vehoil vehu nishba venotel hare ze nishba binkitat chefetz kemo sheyyitbaer behilchot toen: 
Rauhu edim shennichnas letoch bet chavero shello bifne baal habbayit venatal mishsham kelim. af al pi shehotzian megullin veaf al pi shebbaal habbayit hazze asuy limkor et kelav. im taan veamar derech gezel lekachan vehalla omer birshutecha bati veatta mechartam li o netattam li o bechov sheyyesh li etzlecha tefastim eno neeman. shekkol hannichnas levet chavero shello befanav venatal kelim mishsham vehotzian bifne edim hare ze bechezkat gazlan. lefichach machzir hakkelim levaal habbayit veen kan shevua shehare haedim rau ma gazal. veachar sheyyachzir chozer vetovea et baal habbayit bechol ma sheyyiton vehaddin benehen: 
Vechen im haya sham ed echad bilvad uvaal habbayit toen sheggazul hu keli ze beyado vehalla omer lakuach hu beyadi o bechov gevitiv o shelli haya ufikkadon hu etzlecha hare ze chayyav lehachezir hakkeli livalav belo shevua sheillu hayu sham shene edim haya chayyav leshallem veachshav sheen sham ella ed echad chayyav shevua veeno yachol lishshava shehare eno machchish et haed vechol hamechuyyav shevua veeno yachol lishshava meshallem. lefichach im kafar veamar lo nichnasti leveto velo natalti kelum hoil veen sham ella ed echad vehu machchisho hare ze nishba shevuat hattora shello lakach mibbeto kelum veniftar: 
Maase beechad shechataf lashon shel kesef miyyad chavero bifne ed echad. uva hachotef veamar chatafti veshelli chatafti. vechiyyevuhu chachamim lehachezir mippene shehu mechuyyav shevua beed ze veeno yachol lishshava shehare hoda kemo sheamar haed. veillu lo haya sham ed kelal haya nishba shevuat hesset sheshshello chataf. veillu hichchish haed veamar meolam lo chatafti haya nishba shevuat hattora shello chataf. uchedin ze danin bechol kayyotze baze bechol makom: 
Chataf mimmennu zehuvim [beed echad] vehu omer shelli chatafti veesrim hayu af al pi sheen haed yodea kamma chataf hare ze meshallem haesrim shehare yada bevadday shezzehuvim chataf veillu hayu shenayim haya chayyav leshallem venimtza beed echad mechuyyav shevua veeno yachol lishshava kemo shebbearnu: 
Amar hachotef esrim chatafti veshelli hen vehannigzal omer mea chataf hoil veen haed yodea minyanan hare meshallem haesrim shehoda bahen shechatafan venishba shevuat hattora al hashshear shehare nitchayyev bemiktzat. vedati nota baze sheyyishshava hesset shehare lo hoda kelum ella amar shelli chatafti: 
Nichnas leveto shel chavero shello befanav venatal mishsham kelim bifne ed echad veen haed yodea kamma natal (hare) baal habbayit omer esrim kelim hayu beveti vehaggozel omer lo natalti ella asara vehem shelli chayyav lehachezir haasara mippene shehu mechuyyav shevua veeno yachol lishshava. veeno nishba al hashshear afillu shevuat hesset mippene sheeno yachol liton al haggazlan taanat vadday:

Asur liknot davar haggazul min haggazlan veasur lesaado al shinnuyo kede sheyyiknehu. shekkol haose devarim ellu vechayyotze bahen mechazzek yede ovre avera veover al <small>(Vayikra 19 14)</small> "velifne ivver lo titten michshl": 
Asur lehanot bedavar haggazul vaafillu leachar yeush. vehu sheyyeda bevadday sheddavar ze hu haggezela atzmah. ketzad. yada bevadday shebbehema zo gezula asur lirkov aleha o lachrosh bah: 
Gazal bayit o sade asur laavor betochah o likkanes bah bachamma mippene hachamma uvaggeshamim mippene haggeshamim. veim dar betochah chayyav lehaalot sachar labbealim kedin haddar bachatzar chavero shello middato. gazal dekalim veasa mehen gesher asur laavor alav. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Mi sheavar veachal haggezela achar yeush patur milleshallem. veim achal kodem yeush veratzu habbealim ligbot min haochel govin sheadayin birshutan hi. veim ratzu govin min haggazlan: 
Haggozel umet ben sheheechil et haggezela labbanim achar yeush ben shello heechilam ella mecharah o avda. im hinniach karka chayyavin leshallem. aval min hammittaltelin enan chayyavin leshallem. sheddeme haggezela chov hen al haggazlan veen hammittaltelin mishtabedin levaal chov: 
Kevar tikkenu haggeonim ligbot baal chov min hammittaltelin vaafillu bemilve al pe. lefichach chayyavin leshallem ben achlu ben lo achlu. ben nityaashu ben lo nityaashu. ben min hakkarka ben min hammittaltelin shehinniach: 
Din hallokeach mittaltelin min haggazlan kelokeach min haggannav. im gazlan mefursam hu lo asu bo takkanat hashshuk. veim eno mefursam asu bo takkanat hashshuk venoten hannigzal damim shennatan velokeach gezelato vechozer vetovea haggazlan bidme haggezela. veim kevar nityaashu habbealim kana lokeach atzmah shel gezela veeno machzirah:
